subject: I have incredible news
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

This is monumental news, friend: **Ohioans just resoundingly voted to enshrine abortion access in our state’s constitution!**
Voters came out in droves to send a clear message: Ohioans believe women’s health care decisions should be between them and their doctors, not politicians.
Moments like this make me especially proud to be an Ohioan – and to represent my state in the Senate. Now that we've protected abortion access in Ohio, I promise you that I'll continue to work every day to make sure women’s rights to make their own health care decisions are also protected _nationwide._
But here's the deal: **I'm up for reelection, and I'm running against three anti-abortion extremists – all of whom would support a national abortion ban.** The latest polls show us _neck and neck,_ and our Democratic Senate majority is up for grabs. If I'm going to win this race and protect abortion rights from Mitch McConnell, I need your immediate grassroots support.

**FIRST:** Radical Republicans in Ohio tried to undermine our votes and make it more difficult for citizens to pass amendments. _**But thanks to a people-powered team, we were able to defeat them!**_

**THEN:** Folks from across the state of Ohio worked to turn out the vote ahead of the November election. We organized, fundraised and talked to our friends and neighbors so that we could reclaim our reproductive rights.

**AND THAT BRINGS US TO NOW:** We won! Thanks to folks like you and countless grassroots volunteers, **abortion access and reproductive rights are now constitutionally protected in Ohio!**

clean_body: Let me walk you through how we got to this incredible moment: | Peter, Laura Gillen said I could reach out right away and share the news: Issue 1 passed, which means abortion access in Ohio is protected! Let me walk you through how we got to this incredible moment: FIRST: Radical Republicans in Ohio tried to undermine our votes and make it more difficult for citizens to pass amendments. But thanks to a people-powered team, we were able to defeat them! THEN: Folks from across the state of Ohio worked to turn out the vote ahead of the November election. We organized, fundraised and talked to our friends and neighbors so that we could reclaim our reproductive rights. AND THAT BRINGS US TO NOW: We won! Thanks to folks like you and countless grassroots volunteers, abortion access and reproductive rights are now constitutionally protected in Ohio! Peter, this moment proves exactly what we can accomplish when we work together for a better Ohio. While we may take time to celebrate, our fight isn’t over yet. We have to make sure that Republicans can’t pass a federal abortion ban, and to do that we need to flip the House. We’re going to have to fight just as hard as we did to pass Issue 1 to make that happen. subject: Thank you, Kentucky.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ANDY BESHEAR FOR GOVERNOR
body:
Peter,

Last night, Kentucky made a choice. A choice not to move to the right or to the left, but to move forward for all our families.

The people of Kentucky have spoken, and I'm honored to have the opportunity to serve this Commonwealth for another four years! The future is bright, and it's all thanks to you.

But this wasn’t my win. This was our victory. It was a victory that sends a loud, clear message: that anger politics should end right here and right now.

Last night's results are a testament to the countless hours of work, the thousands of volunteers, and the strength of this people-powered campaign. Kentuckians took to the polls to put politics behind us, end partisan fighting, and come together to create a brighter future.

This election shows who we are as Kentuckians. We’re proud people who take care of each other. We believe in the golden rule that says we love our neighbor as ourselves. And the parable of the good Samaritan says that we’re all each other’s neighbors – no exceptions.

Kentuckians understand that our shared values are stronger than anything that could ever pull us apart. And this win is a victory for every single Kentuckian who wants a safe and prosperous life for their family and their community members. We have come so far, and together, we are unstoppable.

I love this commonwealth. I’m going to work as hard as I can for every one of you. From the Beshear family to all of our Kentucky families— thank you, we love you.

God bless,

Andy

As a trauma surgeon, Dr. Brian Williams has treated many women shot by their intimate partners. This issue is personal to him. He lost his cousin when her intimate partner shot and killed her in front of her three children. Allowing domestic abusers to have access to guns endangers our communities, our country, and the lives of those we love.

Domestic violence is a public health crisis in the United States. **When combined with the gun violence epidemic, a terrifying situation of coercion, threats, and deaths is created.**

Each month, an average of 70 women are shot and killed by an intimate partner. In the United States, around 4.5 million women have been threatened with a gun, and 1 million have been shot or shot at. Also, in more than half of mass shootings in the last decade, the shooter shot a current or former intimate partner or family member during a rampage. The deadly reality is that access to a gun makes abusers **five times** more likely to kill their partner.

It doesn't have to be this way. Research proves that taking action — like banning assault weapons, requiring universal background checks, and implementing red flag laws — saves lives. We need to take bold steps, not just from the Supreme Court, but from Congress.

This is monumental news: **Ohioans just resoundingly voted to enshrine abortion access in our state’s constitution!**

Voters came out in droves to send a clear message: Ohioans believe women’s health care decisions should be between them and their doctors, not politicians.

Moments like this make me especially proud to be an Ohioan – and to represent my state in the Senate. Now that we've protected abortion access in Ohio, I promise you that I'll continue to work every day to make sure women’s rights to make their own health care decisions are also protected _nationwide._

But here's the deal: I'm up for reelection, and **I'm running against three anti-abortion extremists – all of whom would support a national abortion ban.** The latest polls show us _neck and neck_ , and our Democratic Senate majority is up for grabs. If I'm going to win this race and protect abortion rights from Mitch McConnell, I need your immediate grassroots support.

**So today, as we celebrate this victory, I'm personally asking you to help me keep up our momentum:** [**Will you chip in $7 or more now, split between me and Fight for Reform to defend Ohio's Democratic seat, protect our pro-choice Senate majority, and elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/33355?t=7&akid=20385%2E4449941%2EiPu1iU) | [CONTRIBUTE »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/33355?t=8&akid=20385%2E4449941%2EiPu1iU)

I haven’t changed, Fellow American.

I still believe that family, faith, and freedom are at the core of America.

I believe in this simple truth: America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world – _but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!_

subject: What a great night for Democrats
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Dear friends, First thing's first - we want to say thank you! Thank you for showing up. Thank you for knocking doors, making calls, talking to your friends - doing everything you could to ensure that we continue to elect candidates who represent our values and are looking out for our communities. Last night, voters across the country made it clear that voters vote, polls don’t. Here are a few key takeaways from the evening.
* In Pennsylvania, the number of absentee ballot returns for youth voters [more than doubled since 2021](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=f2076d8a08&e=d6c5c7d7ec).
* In Ohio, more than 70% of Hispanic voters and more than [80% of Black voters and voters under 30 years old](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=c419677132&e=d6c5c7d7ec) voted to protect reproductive rights.
* In Kentucky, and across the nation, Republicans had a major “[turnout/enthusiasm problem](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=0f36cd3142&e=d6c5c7d7ec)” which helped Democrats re-elect Governor Andy Beshear.
* In Virginia, we were able to beat the odds,flip the House of Delegates, and retain the state Senate, even after Governor Glenn Youngkin made multimillion-dollar investments into districts throughout the state.

Up and down the ballot in races all over the country, Democrats overperformed across the board last night. These wins will allow us to help protect voting rights, abortion rights, and expand access to Medicaid. See a round-up of some of the work our team did to ensure Democrats won across the country. In Solidarity, Brencia Berry & The DNC Coalitions Team
---
|
---
|
## **VA Campus Organizing**
---
| In Virginia, the youth vote was critical to our success on Election day! The DNC, along with our partners in the youth space, engaged young voters through robust and strategic programming, with DNC staff working on-the-ground to support campus organizing on five key campuses across the commonwealth. See some highlights from our work below.
---
|
---
Our team supported half a dozen on-campus events and youth-oriented canvass launches, including an event at University of Mary Washington with Chair Harrison, Joshua Cole, and Joel Griffin, an event at VA Tech in Blacksburg with David Hogg and Lily Franklin, and a youth canvass launch for Travis Nembhard and Danica Roem.
|
---
**Above:** Organizers were on campuses facilitating a youth roundtable to encourage and facilitate collaboration between youth organizations organizing on the ground and across the country to turn out youth voters
|
---
Campus Spotlight: At William and Mary in Williamsburg, there were 750+ provisional ballots cast from first time voters.
* DNC paid for a food truck that provided 250+ meals to students
* [Click here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=26f6465149&e=d6c5c7d7ec) to see a video of students waiting to vote

|
---
|
## Mobilizing Our Communities: GOTV Virtual Phone Banks!
---
|
---
To support the extensive GOTV efforts on the ground, our team planned many distributed phone banks to support our get out the vote efforts with key partners like the Human Rights Campaign, elected officials like Congressman Maxwell Frost, and celebrity surrogates like Brita Filter.

These phone banks attracted hundreds of volunteers and where they completed over one million phone calls and sent nearly two million text messages to voters in races and states across the country with culturally competent and coalition specific content. These calls and texts supported work in...
|
---
* Virginia: Legislative races and 4th Congressional District special election
* Kentucky: Gubernatorial and State Senate District 19 elections
* Pennsylvania: Supreme Court and Allegheny County Executive election.
* Tennessee: State House District 52 and 86 elections
* Ohio: Issue 1 ballot measure
* South Carolina: Greenville mayoral election
* New Hampshire: Manchester mayoral and State House District 1 elections

|
---
|
## HISTORIC WINS ACROSS THE NATION
---
| The 2023 elections ushered in a wave of historic firsts as new leaders take elected office. See a few highlights below.
---
|
---
Cherelle Parker, former Philadelphia council member, became the first female mayor in Philadelphia’s history. Parker ran against Republican David Oh, another former city council member, to become the city’s 100th mayor, succeeding term-limited incumbent Mayor Jim Kenney.
|
---
Exonerated “Central Park Five” member Yusef Salaam won a seat Tuesday on the New York City Council, completing a stunning reversal of fortune decades after he was [wrongly imprisoned](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2f689b33fd&e=d6c5c7d7ec) in an infamous rape case. Salaam, a Democrat, will represent a central Harlem district on the city council, having run unopposed for the seat in one of many local elections held across New York state Tuesday.
|
---
Democrat Gabe Amo is the [projected winner](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=bdd336d421&e=d6c5c7d7ec) of the election for Rhode Island’s 1st Congressional District on Tuesday, according to the NBC News Decision Desk. Amo’s victory makes him the first person of color to represent the Ocean State in Congress.
|
---
|
## Women & Abortion Rights Won Last Night
---
| In one of the most-followed elections yesterday evening, Ohio voters came out to approve Issue 1, a constitutional amendment to enshrine abortion rights into the state constitution, protecting a woman’s right to make decisions about her own body. This is a major victory for Democrats and the women of Ohio, and is another example of voters showing up to protect abortion rights. As we have seen [time and time again](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=1735e9f4a2&e=d6c5c7d7ec) since Roe v. Wade was overturned last year, when abortion rights are on the ballot, reproductive freedom wins. In a [statement yesterday evening](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=de37a4603a&e=d6c5c7d7ec), Vice President Kamala Harris said the following: “The results in Ohio underscore what the vast majority of Americans believe: politicians should not interfere in decisions that should be between a woman and her doctor. Since the Supreme Court decided to overturn Roe v. Wade, people across the country have voted to defend reproductive freedom every time it has appeared on the ballot – including in Kansas, California, Michigan, Montana, Kentucky, and Vermont.”

And it wasn’t just Ohio! In Kentucky, Governor Andy Beshear, who [ran a campaign](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e1d3b502f0&e=d6c5c7d7ec) with his support of abortion rights front and center, was elected to a second term. In Virginia, the [only state in the South](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=56df3105c2&e=d6c5c7d7ec) that has not restricted abortion rights since last year’s Supreme Court decision, Virginians came out and voted to flip the House of Delegates for Democrats, ensuring that anti-abortion Gov. Glenn Youngkin is unable to ban reproductive rights within the state. And in Pennsylvania, Democrat and supporter of abortion rights Dan McCaffery [won an open seat](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=307a06c75c&e=d6c5c7d7ec) on the state Supreme Court, which will now be made up of five Democrats and two Republicans.
---
|
---
|
## ICYMI: Biden Campaign Releases First TV Ad Speaking To Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders
---
|
---
| Biden-Harris 2024 announced the rollout of its Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) paid media program, the earliest investment in AAPI paid media in a presidential election. This program will target AAPI communities across the country through a diverse array of print, TV, and radio advertising. The AAPI media program will kick off with the TV ad “[Family Business](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2119e47315&e=d6c5c7d7ec),” which spotlights Jenny Poon and Odeen Domingo – a husband and wife team who run a small business in Phoenix, Arizona. The spot will run on general market programming in Phoenix, which includes target-rich programming like Dancing With the Stars, Bachelor in Paradise, and high-rated local and network news adjacencies, as well as on national cable news. In the spot, Jenny talks about her experience as a daughter of Vietnamese immigrants who built a small business and how that shaped her into who she is today. Jenny and Odeen explain that President Biden shifting focus to investments in small business and away from large corporations has jump-started small businesses like theirs. Beyond the television spot, the AAPI buy will include print ads in national and local outlets in the battleground states Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. The print ads will be in-language in targeted media outlets and will include buys in the Chinese, Indian, Korean, Filipino, Vietnamese, and broader South Asian communities. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. name: Maurice Mitchell, Working Families Party
subject: About last night
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party National PAC (77 Sands St
body:
These victories and more could not be possible without members like you. | | | Peter, I’m writing to you today from Philadelphia, where last night, we made history. In Philly, the City Council reserves two seats for the minority party — historically, that’s been the Republican Party. We thought Philly deserved better. So in 2019, we disrupted the status quo, challenged the Republicans for two at-large City Council seats, and elected WFP champion Kendra Brooks to the City Council, the first third party candidate to hold a seat. Last night, we did it again. **Not only did we send Kendra Brooks back to the City Council, but she’ll have some back up — because fellow WFP candidate Nicolas O’Rourke will be joining her.** The Republicans and the Democratic establishment fought us every step of the way — but we _won_. Over the last four years, thousands of Philly residents joined our coalition. Yesterday, the Election Day message was clear: **Philadelphia is now a two-party town: Democrats, and the Working Families Party.** We are so proud of our two champions Kendra and Nicolas, and we know they’re going to wake up every day ready to fight for quality schools, clean air and water, and housing you can afford. The future of Philadelphia just got a little brighter. But Philly was far from the only place where WFP made history last night. While we’re still waiting for all the results to come in, here’s a few of our other major victories:
* In **Virginia** , we helped flip the House from Republican control and kept the Democratic majority in the state Senate, putting a stop to Gov. Glenn Youngkin’s entire right-wing, anti-abortion agenda. Our work included electing WFP-endorsed State Senators Danica Roem, Aaron Rouse and Stella Pekarsky, and Delegates Nadarius Clarke, Josh Thomas, Josh Cole, Michael Feggins, and Kelly Fowler,
* In **Ohio** , we threw down and helped push Issue 1 — the state constitutional amendment protecting the fundamental right to an abortion — across the finish line in a resounding win,
* In **Pennsylvania** , climate champion Sara Innamorato toppled the party machine and became the first woman to be elected as Allegheny County Executive. Dan McCaffery was also elected to the PA Supreme Court, bolstering the pro-democracy majority ahead of the 2024 presidential election,
* In **Connecticut** , we won key mayoral and local races and elected at least two candidates to Hartford City Council on the WFP ballot line — Josh Michtom and Alex Thomas — while a third WFP candidate, Tiana Hercules, may be heading to a recount trailing by just _4 votes_ ,
* In **New York** , many of our hundreds of endorsed candidates won across the state including new mayors in New Rochelle and Ithaca and WFP’s very own Maurice Brown to the Onondaga County Legislature. We also re-elected our entire slate to the NYC City Council, with more than a quarter of votes coming on the WFP ballot line in some council districts,
* In **Georgia** , we re-elected Jonesboro Mayor Donya Sartor and elected Teresa Thomas-Smith as the first Black woman as Mayor of Palmetto,
* And we won more victories for WFP candidates in **Colorado, New Jersey, California, North Carolina, Arizona, Washington** , **Texas** , **New Mexico** , and more — and are still monitoring results in other races as votes continue to be counted.

These victories and more could not be possible without members like you. WFP members sent **6 million texts** , knocked on **600,000 doors** , called **540,000 voters** , and sent **30,000 postcards** to help elect these champions and win victories that will resonate now and for years to come — and which will make a real difference in the lives of working people. Some called 2023 an “off-year.” But we knew better. clean_body: These victories and more could not be possible without members like you. | | | Peter, I’m writing to you today from Philadelphia, where last night, we made history. In Philly, the City Council reserves two seats for the minority party — historically, that’s been the Republican Party. We thought Philly deserved better. So in 2019, we disrupted the status quo, challenged the Republicans for two at-large City Council seats, and elected WFP champion Kendra Brooks to the City Council, the first third party candidate to hold a seat. Last night, we did it again. Not only did we send Kendra Brooks back to the City Council, but she’ll have some back up — because fellow WFP candidate Nicolas O’Rourke will be joining her. The Republicans and the Democratic establishment fought us every step of the way — but we won. Over the last four years, thousands of Philly residents joined our coalition. Yesterday, the Election Day message was clear: Philadelphia is now a two-party town: Democrats, and the Working Families Party. We are so proud of our two champions Kendra and Nicolas, and we know they’re going to wake up every day ready to fight for quality schools, clean air and water, and housing you can afford. The future of Philadelphia just got a little brighter. But Philly was far from the only place where WFP made history last night. While we’re still waiting for all the results to come in, here’s a few of our other major victories: In Virginia , we helped flip the House from Republican control and kept the Democratic majority in the state Senate, putting a stop to Gov. Glenn Youngkin’s entire right-wing, anti-abortion agenda. Our work included electing WFP-endorsed State Senators Danica Roem, Aaron Rouse and Stella Pekarsky, and Delegates Nadarius Clarke, Josh Thomas, Josh Cole, Michael Feggins, and Kelly Fowler, In Ohio , we threw down and helped push Issue 1 — the state constitutional amendment protecting the fundamental right to an abortion — across the finish line in a resounding win, In Pennsylvania , climate champion Sara Innamorato toppled the party machine and became the first woman to be elected as Allegheny County Executive. Dan McCaffery was also elected to the PA Supreme Court, bolstering the pro-democracy majority ahead of the 2024 presidential election, In Connecticut , we won key mayoral and local races and elected at least two candidates to Hartford City Council on the WFP ballot line — Josh Michtom and Alex Thomas — while a third WFP candidate, Tiana Hercules, may be heading to a recount trailing by just 4 votes , In New York , many of our hundreds of endorsed candidates won across the state including new mayors in New Rochelle and Ithaca and WFP’s very own Maurice Brown to the Onondaga County Legislature. We also re-elected our entire slate to the NYC City Council, with more than a quarter of votes coming on the WFP ballot line in some council districts, In Georgia , we re-elected Jonesboro Mayor Donya Sartor and elected Teresa Thomas-Smith as the first Black woman as Mayor of Palmetto, And we won more victories for WFP candidates in Colorado, New Jersey, California, North Carolina, Arizona, Washington , Texas , New Mexico , and more — and are still monitoring results in other races as votes continue to be counted. These victories and more could not be possible without members like you. WFP members sent 6 million texts , knocked on 600,000 doors , called 540,000 voters , and sent 30,000 postcards to help elect these champions and win victories that will resonate now and for years to come — and which will make a real difference in the lives of working people. name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: MAGA Republicans just voted to eviscerate environmental protections
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~ ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/G8bxcg-

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ywTdqY-

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

Friends, Our campaign made history one year ago today.**I became the first woman elected to represent Illinois’ 13th District, and we flipped this seat from red to blue for the first time in _nearly three decades._** None of this would’ve been possible without an incredible staff, an army of volunteers, and countless grassroots supporters like you, friend. Together, we showed that we could run a winning campaign centered around the issues that matter most to the people of Central and Southern Illinois – like lowering costs, ensuring fair wages and safe places to work, and making sure working families have a chance to get ahead. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73048037/437253874/398268834?refcode=AU_NJB_CL_GEN_GEN_AC_20231108_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjdhYzA0ZC1hMDdlLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=N-UraIpt0Mhz-87khyPSuiC30kCYKO9r7Xg9HPiHlRA=) And since then, I’ve rolled up my sleeves to make real progress on these issues. I’ve introduced countless bipartisan bills to deliver critical funds and resources to support our rural communities and improve our district’s crumbling infrastructure, and right now, I’m working across the aisle every day to get the Farm Bill across the finish line. **But our work is far from over. I’m up for reelection next November, and two right-wing opponents have already entered the race. We can’t let them flip this seat and reverse all of our hard-won progress.** National Republicans are going to spend millions of dark money to boost these candidates as they look to hold onto their slim House majority, so we’re gearing up for another long fight ahead. By continuing our work together, I know that we can overcome any challenge that comes our way. We can — and we will — remain laser-focused in our fight to deliver progress for working families across our country. clean_body: | Friends, Our campaign made history one year ago today.I became the first woman elected to represent Illinois’ 13th District, and we flipped this seat from red to blue for the first time in nearly three decades. None of this would’ve been possible without an incredible staff, an army of volunteers, and countless grassroots supporters like you, friend. Together, we showed that we could run a winning campaign centered around the issues that matter most to the people of Central and Southern Illinois – like lowering costs, ensuring fair wages and safe places to work, and making sure working families have a chance to get ahead. = And since then, I’ve rolled up my sleeves to make real progress on these issues. I’ve introduced countless bipartisan bills to deliver critical funds and resources to support our rural communities and improve our district’s crumbling infrastructure, and right now, I’m working across the aisle every day to get the Farm Bill across the finish line. But our work is far from over. I’m up for reelection next November, and two right-wing opponents have already entered the race. We can’t let them flip this seat and reverse all of our hard-won progress. National Republicans are going to spend millions of dark money to boost these candidates as they look to hold onto their slim House majority, so we’re gearing up for another long fight ahead. By continuing our work together, I know that we can overcome any challenge that comes our way. We can — and we will — remain laser-focused in our fight to deliver progress for working families across our country. Thank you again, Nikki | = Nikki for Congress PO Box 5171 Springfield, IL 62705 United States ** | mailto:info@nikkiforcongress.com | Paid for by Nikki Budzinski for Congress

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: American Briefing
subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp725b402j900hotjknfas3klcd5872u3m38raq8_rp22sh2s8i66p74slh62o36cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp66o94o83gs08skg4vi4ge26j86vdvn8huf4osg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slh62o36cdh2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2kg4n3jdgt04qj9tu3k5skjq95fjsjuk8l4a83g_rp22sh2s8i66p74slh62o36cdh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zed6vdl710c06m3lpi6eh92htk7tp85btb4bjcfg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slh62o36cdh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkmjued5pccvbah6peq3rchphpvskqnhpgls9nkg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slh6eor5cth2bs)
---
Hello Friend, Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return? _When we all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!_ _When we all see Jesus, we’ll sing and shout the victory!_ The words of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ’s return is going to be glorious! **But between now and then, how should we live**? What does God’s Word say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ... **what should our response be?**
---
| | When I have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation, which I’ve found helps provide answers and strength in these dark days. And today, I’m pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the book of Revelation entitled _Final Conquest._ Final Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It’s all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event in human history. This book will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn’t want you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God’s plan as never before — you’ll be encouraged!

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: about last night
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

_“Abortion Issue Burns GOP Again, as Democrats Take a Big Election Night.”_

That headline from this morning was from ABC News.

You’ve probably seen dozens of similar articles from the press after last night’s disappointing election results in _Kentucky_ , _Ohio_ , and _Virginia_ , all predicting doom in 2024 for Republicans if they don’t try something new on abortion.

So, I have an idea. Why don’t Republicans at _every_ level of government start campaigning on abortion like this?

**_Killing little preborn boys and girls is WRONG_.**
**_It should be illegal, and I will work to make it so_.**
**_And the abortionists who prey on women and commit these killings should be in jail_.**
You see, Pro-Life Friend, for all of the bluster from the media and weak-kneed GOP consultants who tell Republicans to run away from the abortion issue and then blame abortion when they lose, _Republicans have STILL not actually fought on abortion_.

After the fall of _Roe v. Wade,_ Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell (R-KY) refused to even support a federal late-term abortion prevention act.

In 2023, Republicans in Ohio tried to turn _Issue 1_ into a referendum on “parental rights” when our own exit polling showed that nearly 100% of the Gen Z voters who voted against the amendment did so because they were voting against abortion.

Their strategy was so confusing, a leading GOP pollster I talked to told me that one-quarter of those who said they supported Ohio _Issue 1_ described themselves as pro-life!

If you and I won all the votes of all pro-lifers, _Issue 1_ would have been defeated – even despite the fact that we were massively outspent.

And in Virginia, local news media was falling all over themselves at how Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin raised millions of dollars for his “Spirit of Virginia” PAC from big-wig GOP donors all over the country.

Governor Youngkin spent that money on a TV ad campaign stating **“ _Here’s the truth: There is no ban_ ”** on abortion.

_The moment that ad came out, our team saw the energy from pro-lifers around the Old Dominion tank as many just felt punched in the gut_.

The 15-week “limit” Governor Youngkin said he would support would have allowed _at least_ 94% of abortions across the state continue.

France has a national 14-week ban. So, Governor Youngkin’s position – the great hope of establishment Republicans – isn’t even more conservative than France.

But it didn’t stop Democrats from sounding the alarm on abortion.

Governor Youngkin’s genius political move managed to energize his enemies while deflating his base – which virtually always results in lower turnout.

But the strongest pro-life candidates did just fine.

For example, State Senate candidate Tara Durant was attacked incessantly by the Left for her stand for Life and _SFLAction’s_ support of her candidacy.

But as I write you, she’s leading by 2.2% with 97% of the vote counted.

_On the House side, we now have two _Students for Life_ alumni in Virginia’s House of Delegates – Delegate-Elects Mark Earley and Tim Griffin_!

And whether it’s Kentucky, Ohio, or Virginia, you and I were outspent in all of those races.

The only race where Republicans weren’t outspent was Mississippi – _which is the only state they won._

THAT definitely cannot be allowed to continue.

**But it seems the higher up the GOP ladder you climb, the more folks you meet who are just out of touch with their own voters.**

The consultant class, political insiders, and MANY GOP politicians either don’t really believe abortion is wrong.

**_Or they don’t care – because they won’t ever say that abortion is wrong_.**

And in so doing, they’re surrendering – completely stripping the morality and the humanity from the abortion issue.

These are the same people that told us that _Roe v. Wade_ would never be reversed.

But we proved them wrong.

And that is the lesson our movement must learn from last night’s elections.

**Our mission to end abortion is a marathon, not a sprint.**

Cultural transformation takes time.

But we are here for it.

**_And we aren’t going away_.**

Because we can’t . . . the lives of babies are on the line.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

But as I write you, she’s leading by 2.2% with 97% of the vote counted. On the House side, we now have two Students for Life alumni in Virginia’s House of Delegates – Delegate-Elects Mark Earley and Tim Griffin! And whether it’s Kentucky, Ohio, or Virginia, you and I were outspent in all of those races. The only race where Republicans weren’t outspent was Mississippi – which is the only state they won. THAT definitely cannot be allowed to continue. But it seems the higher up the GOP ladder you climb, the more folks you meet who are just out of touch with their own voters. The consultant class, political insiders, and MANY GOP politicians either don’t really believe abortion is wrong. Or they don’t care – because they won’t ever say that abortion is wrong. And in so doing, they’re surrendering – completely stripping the morality and the humanity from the abortion issue. These are the same people that told us that Roe v. Wade would never be reversed. But we proved them wrong. And that is the lesson our movement must learn from last night’s elections. Our mission to end abortion is a marathon, not a sprint. Cultural transformation takes time. But we are here for it. And we aren’t going away. Because we can’t . . . the lives of babies are on the line. body:
This might be your only warning.

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_“Food shortages are coming.”_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35142%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6YVQLM52bJ3Ikumta9kegw&sysid=1). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35143%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1jej8p9oXfCdvzzCwKxVUw&sysid=1) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. [**Stock up now**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35144%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bBaciELp%2bFZeRBH1T3pCGg&sysid=1) on these survival food kits while you can.

subject: Truths from Revelation
body:
Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673632%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jNYeFW5g4OcCpC3b34%2fTnw&sysid=1)
---
Hello Friend, Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return? _When we all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!_ _When we all see Jesus, we’ll sing and shout the victory!_ The words of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ’s return is going to be glorious! **But between now and then, how should we live**? What does God’s Word say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ... **what should our response be?**
---
| | When I have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation, which I’ve found helps provide answers and strength in these dark days. And today, I’m pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the book of Revelation entitled _Final Conquest._ Final Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It’s all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event in human history. This book will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn’t want you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God’s plan as never before -- you’ll be encouraged!
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673632%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jNYeFW5g4OcCpC3b34%2fTnw&sysid=1)
---

You can make your most generous donation here: [https://secure.ptv.org/final-conquest-generous-gift-kit-1](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673633%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=muiCQbzLS3AH5nxLu%2bts%2bg&sysid=1) One day soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King of kings and Lord of lords will return and make His final conquest. Until that moment, we are focusing our hope on Christ and working together to proclaim the gospel and expand His coming kingdom. Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

Friend,

There is no clearer contrast between Joe Biden and the energy we brought to the stage last night at the third Republican debate. We just gave the nation a preview of what the nation will see in the 2024 general election, and the response we’re getting now is unbelievable.

Now is the time to take action. We put in the work standing up to the challengers last night, but we are just getting started. We are facing a chance to maximize our momentum TODAY if we step up and make this victory a steppingstone to the next stage of our campaign, but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented show of support for our mission.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=12f4abca329cd70c0690943b094496edbe1ae5f7ca525913f03ab7845149117e582b59821270571ffeaeac38dc26fa4c87213551ecee0e023085c454bcdc006a
SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN NOW: DONATE $25 HERE

Now that the nation has gotten another chance to see what we’re fighting for, here’s what they know:

-

We WILL put an end to the absurd claims that men can get pregnant.

-

We WILL throw every sexually-explicit material they’ve tried to shove into our nation’s elementary schools in the garbage—where it belongs.

-

We WILL go straight to the southern border, ARMED, and leave Mexican drug cartel members trying to bring thousands of pounds of fentanyl near young Americans STONE COLD DEAD.

-

We WILL fire every bureaucrat that siphons off tax-payer dollars to fund ineffective, corrupt, useless agencies.

-

We WILL hold federal leaders accountable for the harm they’ve done to adult Americans and the futures of American children.

-

We WILL restore our American dominance and strength from our military to our manufacturing, to our energy sector.

-

We WILL END our toxic, abusive relationship with China, and declare our economic independence from foreign adversaries.

# A Tale of Two Veterans
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
This is the story of two Military Veterans named Pat with a Southern Nevada connection.
Pat Veteran Number One: Pat Tillman was a standout college and professional football player. Early in his NFL career with the Arizona Cardinals and being named to the 2001 NFL's All-Pro team, 9/11 hit. At season's end, Pat turned down a $3.6M contract and enlisted in the Army with his little brother Kevin. Pat would qualify as an elite Army Airborne Ranger and was deployed to Afghanistan. Shortly after arriving in the country, on a combat patrol near the border with Pakistan, Pat was killed. In recognition of his valiant service, Pat was posthumously awarded the Silver Star, the Purple Heart, and the Meritorious Service Medal. In 2010, the newly constructed bridge over the Colorado River was named the Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge in his honor. Pat Veteran Number Two: Patricia Huntley was born in 1936 in Boston. After high school, Pat was awarded a scholarship to a nursing program. During that time, she went to the theater and saw "The Lieutenant Wore Skirts." So moved by the film she immediately went to the recruiting station and joined the Navy. She graduated top in her class from the Navy's Hospital Corp School. While in training, she met a fellow sailor named Lee. They started dating, eventually married; and when it was time to start a family, Pat's Navy service ended, and she was honorably discharged from the Navy. So, what is Patricia's connection to Southern Nevada? Eventually, she and Lee would move to Henderson, where Pat taught nursing at UNLV and CSN. Pat and Lee now lie side-by-side in the Boulder City Veterans' Memorial Cemetery. Though Patricia served less than two years in the Navy, her service would inspire others. Her first two sons joined the military: one in the Navy and the other in the Army. A grandson and granddaughter would also serve. Pat, or should I say, Patty, as only my dad could call her, was my Mom. Like almost all veterans who serve, my mom doesn't have a bridge or memorial named after her. Most veterans humbly serve the country they love, then return home to their families and communities. Some give their life, while others give a lifetime of service. This Veterans' Day, it is my prayer that we remember them all.
---
Questions and Answers
Q: What is Mark's military background? -J.P. A. Mark enlisted in the Army as a Private and retired as a Colonel. He deployed to ten different countries, including combat zones in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Kuwait. Mark was selected as Company and Battalion Commander. He served in the Pentagon and was on the faculty of the National Defense University. In 2017, he was a U.S. Delegate to the Global Coalition Against ISIS. This 68-nation coalition devised the strategies that defeated the ISIS caliphate in Iraq and Syria. Mark's awards and decorations include the Legion of Merit, Bronze Star, Meritorious Serve Medal, Secretary of Defense Badge, and Airborne Wings.

Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for Mark? Simply reply to this email to ask Mark a question.

At season's end, Pat turned down a $3.6M contract and enlisted in the Army with his little brother Kevin. Pat would qualify as an elite Army Airborne Ranger and was deployed to Afghanistan. Shortly after arriving in the country, on a combat patrol near the border with Pakistan, Pat was killed. In recognition of his valiant service, Pat was posthumously awarded the Silver Star, the Purple Heart, and the Meritorious Service Medal. In 2010, the newly constructed bridge over the Colorado River was named the Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge in his honor. Pat Veteran Number Two: Patricia Huntley was born in 1936 in Boston. After high school, Pat was awarded a scholarship to a nursing program. During that time, she went to the theater and saw "The Lieutenant Wore Skirts." So moved by the film she immediately went to the recruiting station and joined the Navy. She graduated top in her class from the Navy's Hospital Corp School. While in training, she met a fellow sailor named Lee. They started dating, eventually married; and when it was time to start a family, Pat's Navy service ended, and she was honorably discharged from the Navy. So, what is Patricia's connection to Southern Nevada? Eventually, she and Lee would move to Henderson, where Pat taught nursing at UNLV and CSN. Pat and Lee now lie side-by-side in the Boulder City Veterans' Memorial Cemetery. Though Patricia served less than two years in the Navy, her service would inspire others. Her first two sons joined the military: one in the Navy and the other in the Army. A grandson and granddaughter would also serve. Pat, or should I say, Patty, as only my dad could call her, was my Mom. Like almost all veterans who serve, my mom doesn't have a bridge or memorial named after her. Most veterans humbly serve the country they love, then return home to their families and communities. Some give their life, while others give a lifetime of service. This Veterans' Day, it is my prayer that we remember them all. Questions and Answers Q: What is Mark's military background? -J.P. A. Mark enlisted in the Army as a Private and retired as a Colonel. He deployed to ten different countries, including combat zones in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Kuwait. Mark was selected as Company and Battalion Commander. He served in the Pentagon and was on the faculty of the National Defense University. In 2017, he was a U.S. Delegate to the Global Coalition Against ISIS. This 68-nation coalition devised the strategies that defeated the ISIS caliphate in Iraq and Syria. Mark's awards and decorations include the Legion of Merit, Bronze Star, Meritorious Serve Medal, Secretary of Defense Badge, and Airborne Wings. Please share this message with friends and neighbors. name: Your America
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35250%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rqp8o9OiY%2fNC0KC2b7XeTg&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35251%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jxT4we61uq%2f0pnNzcBL6VQ&sysid=1)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35252%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SpShKcbpTzvzQSoZ8UBT1w&sysid=1)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

November 9, 2023 Ever since the atrocious and barbaric attack on Israel by Hamas on October 7th, Jim Himes has been interviewed multiple times on all the networks for his views on the attack. In each case he has reiterated his view that the attack was an atrocity committed by Hamas, and that Israel is "thoroughly justified in defending itself." His verbiage indicates he wants to be seen as someone firmly in support of Israel as it faces what may well be the gravest threat to its existence since its founding. However, Mr. Himes was elected to REPRESENT us with his VOTES in the House, not gab about his myriad and endless points-of-view on cable TV. As is the case with so many, many pressing issues of the day, Himes' constituents in Fairfield County watching talking-head TV, were given the impression he would ACT on the assurances he made on the airways. But they would be wrong and mis-led, yet again. When [H.R.6126: Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Act](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016AhQqa7aGt_zfs_Tu4OAl4RRFUvIzNuSDLpw5qx4os6HiAelCIeE-fqRvMhWOH5Y0Ls1M0pB3gn7r0BiVNFZtlKzfnOZTFvqmG3K5E70A9X6T24gTOW1o3X0H1LNithpENHVufvd_nfMViRKKVqKyz79KYxn49vPiAg2bh09g-sAY8UkwISd3k8b8cc2LK5Z&c=f06ILZl6kPaP8D3esvPBScAkRm4TjrnirfKZ5ZkZLb86vPHZII5rtA==&ch=uUAXeeUlD0MtLTtqY3muQ225qZ0q2ABaNrprBcv2IU6o4T-R2PxPKA==) came to the floor for a vote in the House last week, Jim Himes voted AGAINST supporting Israel. That's right - and he sure hasn't mentioned that little detail in subsequent TV interviews. Since Himes neither mentioned nor explained this despicable vote, his mouthpiece Democrat leader Hakeem Jeffries made it clear that the $14 billion Israel aid package had to be joined with Ukrainian aid, which is otherwise destined for a much tougher negotiation. In addition, Himes and the Democrats want to borrow the money for the aid, rather than take it from already approved funds. And to top it off, Himes and the Dems just HAD to vote against newly elected speaker Mike Johnson's first proposed bill. These are the utterly cynical budget games Himes and the Democrats have deployed for the past 15 years, which have directly led to ballooning the national debt from nine to $33 trillion. The Israel Aid bill passed the House with just 12 Democrat votes in the affirmative. While the House Democrats are left to stew in the poisonous juice of their failed gambit against Israeli aid, this Hamas attack has ripped open and exposed a mighty schism within their fraudulent Party. At least since the rise of the Marxist 'Squad' in 2018 made their influence visible, Marxist and radical Islamist ideology has been increasing its influence within the Party. It has now quite demonstrably spilled into the streets and campuses across America for all to see, and can no longer be bottled-up. And quite rightly, many Jewish leaders are publicly aghast at the reality of it all displayed before them in daily news reports. Liberal Jewish influencers had long been a reliably Democrat voting-block. But for the past decade or more, the Democrats have been duplicitously cultivating both votes and campaign funding from radical subversive groups. It has now become a time-for-choosing. And Mr. Himes, in the middle of it, is as usual trying to have it both ways. Democrat leaders who already condemned the Hamas attack as an atrocity are still trying to placate their two irreconcilable internal factions. Some are now calling for a 'ceasefire,' while Biden himself has called for a temporary 'pause' - these gambits clearly favor Hamas, who will only use the breathing space to advance their war aims. We've seen this play before - Hamas commits the terrorist atrocity, and after Israel mounts its response, complicit national and world leaders call for a ceasefire before Israel can root out the source of the violence - Hamas!
Jim Himes has signaled he is traveling this road as well; except he has inserted an interim step in the process. Himes has emphatically stated near the end of this [video interview](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016AhQqa7aGt_zfs_Tu4OAl4RRFUvIzNuSDLpw5qx4os6HiAelCIeE-fqRvMhWOH5YZ866oy5Ho5gON3A87GDxy8h3gJVjiibo4hKAFr063_Zv4aYLT4PloTsJLqvcQbVuRBq07eiNfHZvvNuP0dOv83zC6KH2TIyRP5p-pb_Wwt1LYiRRwJDPgfRjUQQ-C-0k7vCwNR5zxGZ8czE_XZFG5GTalykgutkT&c=f06ILZl6kPaP8D3esvPBScAkRm4TjrnirfKZ5ZkZLb86vPHZII5rtA==&ch=uUAXeeUlD0MtLTtqY3muQ225qZ0q2ABaNrprBcv2IU6o4T-R2PxPKA==) that in its response Israel must "observe the laws of armed conflict." Those 'laws' apply to nation-states, not a terrorist organization. Let's not be confused - this call is nothing more than another hampering of Israel's self-defense objectives. Deploying such a straddle is nothing new for Mr. Himes. At a Himes town hall in July of 2021, I called out the Squad members by name, reminded Himes of their unrelenting public degradation of the U.S., and challenged him to publicly denounce them and their Marxist faction. In a [video](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016AhQqa7aGt_zfs_Tu4OAl4RRFUvIzNuSDLpw5qx4os6HiAelCIeE-fqRvMhWOH5Y7MDZ5ChrEV9XaoDIkT0T7jG7-bXRcpuklr6smRyImx2Bv34mkJXKDufLGnlncdgGq26vMW2vyRnxainLDcElJA==&c=f06ILZl6kPaP8D3esvPBScAkRm4TjrnirfKZ5ZkZLb86vPHZII5rtA==&ch=uUAXeeUlD0MtLTtqY3muQ225qZ0q2ABaNrprBcv2IU6o4T-R2PxPKA==) of that confrontation you can see Himes' usual, tired deflection of the core issue while he tangled himself parsing their words. ## Haley, Ramaswamy Spar at GOP Debate
The third GOP presidential debate was more orderly than the first two, despite Vivek Ramaswamy's continued attacks on Nikki Haley over China and her daughter's use of TikTok. Her response: "[You're just scum.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DHToyAQgOFfox0OLKihsLjGLtde6aywxo0IGSE6-fc3-eqvfptn3n_36Y4cOD7-4k5DWdKErvBJk1LCCtCTqf2wEAHpmgbVWdtqA7ar16Gf5exb2ffKur71rZGzQ0--J2NvvdU1DyBBKyWtkq0B07SIgIvtbtgZDUtfGUmeSzqaZ-JYVlrCJ510NC7tdRjWUl650n8qGCsYr-tq4uwiXfnbKxhfKXBhlysYQYIRFMgVTrGC8fnORWT33kXkbWOxYqCPWPigLGZ0mzj5pE0cuGO-cP9kgaWg27I4XEQFRkNXH4N_XRwC5-5LfezI4YdWfh31PwAA__9IzGs8)" Substantively, the first hour focused on foreign affairs, and the second hour on domestic issues. None of the candidates attacked Donald Trump directly and his name barely came up, even though he's leading in the polls by more than 40 points. Trump himself skipped the debate and instead held a rally for the Cuban-American community in Hialeah, Fla., where [lines stretched for blocks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFy6yAQheGnQR0aWBAWBcVt6HzblJoVrKzNIKORiRW_fcapU5_iO_N_XKcrcuH77T9uFNpSJ0yNnzRpLb0EM9kuh4UIyHQUtPN-MBa869aQhlnlwadFXwyCUmMicnOax5wcjmA7DqDAaK28VoMF2w-IgIt3IzprYLkIqyhzq0f_WfneVlrKqz7p6FPduhLW1vaHMP8ERAHxPM8ev7k-3quAWGrCIiBujBsLiG9LQNRaQFReQMz1jiXLdnxtuzywlJdcGQvhKm91l5lmbNQdIe8nl8IP9_5z25DLr9_-rPETAAD__9ClX9E) hours ahead of time.
## House Subpoenas Biden Family Members
The House Judiciary Committee issued [subpoenas for Hunter Biden and his uncle James Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAUhH8NbETwwKQMDF28pWtH69l-BCoMliGJ-u-reO52p5NOn77v23TDlFO5f-FGvoc64dLTkyalhBOgJ8NXH4iANCevrHODNuAsj35BmK1bSA6LtW4mpFUHvEKY0V0xSJ48SNBKSafkYMBcBkTA4OwHWqMhXJmRtKZej8tPTaVHCvm3Pum4LHXj2cfe98b0J4ORwdgjxZTze2MwxrpRoVc746MRg9FoKaVR4uziXnfRHvNeqWAT8VE6HWJOKxUGIz_8ur9SzqnZN8V9w3Q-8_6vg78AAAD__xxZXio), brother of President Joe Biden, as part of its ongoing impeachment investigation. Additionally, the committee has requested testimony from other family members, including [Sara Biden, wife of James, and Hallie Biden,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGL4zAQBeBfI3cy0kixrULFweEux3VbGlke2bPIVrAmCfn3S5Ytt3nN48HH-7hO10CZjvVf2NFzKlOITA-ctJZOgplss_iECGga9Lpz7mIsuK7ZfFQDzn3sXXLRzSmBS84BxBCN7qJWDXlQYLRWTquLBdteQoCQXDeEzhpIvbAKF-Jytp-FDt4w5Vd54NnGsjfZb8y3KswfAaOAMczxwGdt1_KuBYz_SyamWAWMW7lXlO9ppXVjGcu-EzOirPf5VvAIcrsfjKecacHjJ1PYKb8EjJXL-RJmpEWYv1rZHtww2Ob0y-1JOVPt3tR1D5S_afzrUV8BAAD__99FayY) widow of President Biden's son Beau.

Hunter's lawyer said the president's son [is "eager" to testify](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSrCAQheGn0QwLG3GGgOAmZnPTDa1Wm7G3ECzAcX37rdlNN_5P8NX5eIwPZM_h-R83ssXFEefCLxrbVhgBauzqxToiIFWTbXtjtOrA9PVqje7uUjuQkjT0-oZKLtNtAnKwKCOnmi1IUG0rTSt1B12jEQGd6e_YdwrcreokLVxiaj4jh7KS81d8UWrmuNXerqXsuVL_KhgqGM7zbFz8CnTmd69g2KPnwnOuYFiPUCiJiRcKgvBJSRTKhd0l9mPyPAsX07GJOW6URD6mPVLA380WwyU8nte74JXrZJf9ZO8592_ic0P2P6Ty50HfAQAA__9jIWqr) in a public forum, while the White House and other leading Democrats denounced the investigation as an evidence-free "smear campaign."
## Fight Looms Over History's Biggest Treasure
Colombia declared a national mission to raise the "Holy Grail of shipwrecks," the sunken Spanish galleon _San Jose_ with its lost treasure of 200 tons of gold, silver, and emeralds worth up to $20 billion. [See video of it here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuxCAQBNCvsTsss6y5ULhI4-7SprQwLGcSDBaQQ_f3kVOnntHoaT7v61374OPjQx80V5dWbap_0so5UwzEir2dHRGQ6GnmUqlJICjZ77NEJHQGYCNEQ1ZKJzQaNXInHMex9zOMIDgfFR8nBBwmrUE7Jd-0RAHu1uFI1teUh6_kY93JhVd6Uh5MOvow77WepRPvHSwdLK21IW4mUitX3sESU-tgeXpLqYPFpJCOzevIzkzFW4qVpWwpF5bJXLMvlhyDkW0-BJ8iK7s_WybzzWomXX4yMa5uME0gbhPyPs_2bFe3yIv6OLQPf7T671G_AQAA__-A3Wrl). The ship sank off Colombia in 1708, and the wreck wasn't discovered by Colombian divers until 2015. But a U.S. salvage company claims it found the wreck in 1981 and [is fighting in arbitration for $10 billion,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8GNhA8MA4DQ1XJQ6V06dDRerafYxpsIkxi5e-rSB273nKn-z73Z4wpbpdPXCnUOfc41vigXmvhBZje8inMRECGU9DO-8ZY8I4vYaTBtMogTERaOZi986Y5TapVg2-s4jGAAqO18lo1FqxsEAFn707orIG5ZVbRFGsu8ifHrS40p2d-UJFjXnkKS623nZk3Bh2D7jgOOWFMzxVjkmOW9yuDbqNjZ9BhqXFMJDS02lrlGXRfuImPvJPYl3g7Co1XUQvhfi8k3nPK6xBRgBJDTCnmTS51TbyE6Xa8wO5edZc_18rrv29-AwAA__8DmGUs) or half the treasure. In its arbitration filing, Colombian officials say the U.S. firm gave the wrong coordinates in its report and never actually found what it calls ["the biggest treasure in the history of humanity."](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOozAQxvGngW6QPXYcXLi4Jl2uvRINMIQ5GYxsJyhvv8puu_2nTz_9_92HO0mU_fGXNg51SQNNVV48aA0e0Ay2ncPCjGxaDtp5fzEWvWvXMDo0xhutrpOZ0PfLZK1D1TPPIyP1rQRUaLRWXquLRdtdiJAW73py1uBybaziWWrK3f8ke115ie_04txNaWtjWGs9SmP-NHhr8HaeZzc-i-xciuxF5p9dg7cpxbSNQjBSrZHhcwFZHmstYJSCN1OGFGcoB-1SVjgpl1UOqJmpPDPDxwlatznMxykxSnEf3GMjid-Y-muarwAAAP__pUVmdw)

**This is urgent: Arizona saw a 50% DECLINE in monarch sightings this fall compared to last year.**
Each fall, monarch butterflies embark on their epic migration to their wintering grounds in Mexico. And for many, their beautiful black and orange wings are an indicator that the fall season is upon us. But as production of butterfly-harming Roundup continues, **we’re seeing fewer and fewer of these backyard beauties.** That’s because Roundup’s main ingredient, glyphosate, is harming monarchs, our health, and our planet. So we have to get it OUT of our environment before monarchs are lost forever. **[Friend, donate $27 today and help us reach our $5,200 goal to help protect monarchs, people, and the planet!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2108524?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
Why is glyphosate so bad for monarchs? Well, monarch butterflies rely on a vital plant to ensure their species’ survival -- milkweed. It’s the ONLY food source for monarch caterpillars. And it’s the only plant that monarchs lay their eggs on. But glyphosate is wiping out milkweed. **And no milkweed means no baby monarchs!**
Pollinator-killer Bayer-Monsanto knows the cost our pollinators are paying while they rake in the profits. But still, glyphosate is the most widely used pesticide in the world. All the while, monarch butterfly populations are plummeting, and people exposed to products like Roundup are facing health risks. Friends of the Earth is putting everything we have into protecting our ecosystems and planet from toxic pesticides,**but we need your support to make an impact.**

**Monarchs must be protected before we lose them forever. Donate $27 today and help us reach our $5,200 goal for the future of monarchs, people, and the planet! **

---
A recent study highlighted a frightening fact: every single sample of milkweed collected was contaminated with pesticides -- one-third with levels deadly to monarchs. **Young monarchs are hatching on milkweed coated with toxic pesticides, and their first meal may be their last.**
As it stands, Roundup usage shows no signs of slowing. In fact, the use of Bayer-Monsanto's Roundup increased by over 2,600% from 1987 to 2016. **And as a result, milkweed plants are being virtually wiped out across the monarch’s migration path.**
But Bayer-Monsanto doesn’t seem concerned about harming butterflies, our health, and our planet as long as it gets its payday. What’s worse -- the corporation knows how dangerous its product is. It’s even gone so far as to MANIPULATE science to keep Roundup stocked and selling. And it’s lying to consumers, too.
That’s right, Friend. The dangers of glyphosate reach beyond monarch butterflies. Glyphosate has been linked to severe health concerns, like hormone disruption, shortened pregnancy, and even cancer. And it might surprise you to learn that **children are the most AT RISK!** You see, glyphosate is found in many foods, and it is being sprayed on lawns, gardens, and parks. So children playing outdoors are being exposed to this toxic chemical.
Bayer-Monsanto can’t get away with this. Roundup is causing extensive harm that must be stopped before it's too late. How long will we let the pesticide industry operate this way, putting people, pollinators, and the planet in harm’s way?
**Monarchs, children, and the planet shouldn’t pay the price for corporate greed. Donate $27 today before it’s too late! **

At Friends of the Earth, we are taking the fight to Congress, the Biden administration, and corporations. We’re advocating for our elected leaders to pass the Saving America’s Pollinators Act and to ban the use of key toxic pesticides. We’re pushing for monarchs to be listed and receive full protections under the Endangered Species Act. And we’re demanding retailers like Home Depot and Lowe’s stop selling Roundup in their stores and online.
In short, we are fighting on every front to save these pollinators. But Friend, we need you by our side as we ramp up our efforts to save monarchs from extinction and protect our planet.
To put it bluntly, our health and planet are paying the price for the greed of companies like Bayer-Monsanto. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. The stakes are too high to wait a minute more to take action. Young monarch butterflies don’t have a safe food source, and they’re dying soon after hatching. Meanwhile, monarchs are running out of places to lay their eggs in the first place. Monarch populations are in freefall -- **the time to act is now, while there are still monarchs left to save.**
With each passing day, and as toxic pesticide use grows, we may only get the rarest glimpses of these beautiful butterflies. Future generations may never experience the beauty of seeing a monarch butterfly on a fall day. Will you be one of the 21 people in your area today that will make a membership contribution today to help protect monarchs, people, and the planet?

Monarchs, children, and the planet shouldn’t pay the price for corporate greed. Donate $27 today before it’s too late! If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: == == == == At Friends of the Earth, we are taking the fight to Congress, the Biden administration, and corporations. We’re advocating for our elected leaders to pass the Saving America’s Pollinators Act and to ban the use of key toxic pesticides. We’re pushing for monarchs to be listed and receive full protections under the Endangered Species Act. And we’re demanding retailers like Home Depot and Lowe’s stop selling Roundup in their stores and online. In short, we are fighting on every front to save these pollinators. But Friend, we need you by our side as we ramp up our efforts to save monarchs from extinction and protect our planet. To put it bluntly, our health and planet are paying the price for the greed of companies like Bayer-Monsanto. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. The stakes are too high to wait a minute more to take action. Young monarch butterflies don’t have a safe food source, and they’re dying soon after hatching. Meanwhile, monarchs are running out of places to lay their eggs in the first place. Monarch populations are in freefall -- the time to act is now, while there are still monarchs left to save. With each passing day, and as toxic pesticide use grows, we may only get the rarest glimpses of these beautiful butterflies. Future generations may never experience the beauty of seeing a monarch butterfly on a fall day. Will you be one of the 21 people in your area today that will make a membership contribution today to help protect monarchs, people, and the planet? Help us stand up to Bayer-Monsanto and protect monarchs, people, and our planet. Donate $27 and help us reach our $5,200 goal before midnight! | | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

| | Peter,

Censorship. It's coming for you and it's a threat to our American discourse. I hope you'll [watch my most recent podcast ](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=69f8a9cbc2&e=9828080a05)on the issue by clicking the thumbnail below or [listening to it wherever you listen to podcasts](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=1e634c5e51&e=9828080a05).

---
| I am astonished at the every-day censorship people face. From medical decisions to political stories that don’t fit the mainstream narrative, we actually take for granted how much the truth is being hidden from us. We must be relentless in calling out the coordinated censorship by Big Tech, Big Pharma, and Big Government.

[I hope you'll tune in](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=9fac6e16af&e=9828080a05), leave a comment, and stay engaged. As the last week taught us, the political fight doesn't always go our way - but Vince Lombardi had a great quote I often reflect on: "I firmly believe that any man's finest hour, the greatest fulfillment of all that he holds dear, is that moment when he has worked his heart out in a good cause and lies exhausted on the field of battle - victorious."

We _will_ know victory if we are persistent, consistent, and insistent that we want to see change.

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=649585cf07d74ce2b8338a9512abd708&_e=yjLbbsOtMup16qWi8NHc19YKb2uo1n9wFwhdMh3_aXqP2ojntL_2OoBoXRAY9P6x2VeKJstvGfCD0WHDoqgBntaP7Bn8ZC4w7lciciKHT6yUppSJP_-CZprMy5YdZvwf3mpFOM5QXAqyS1ubp-utUQs0SJ6WbJI33FFFDbTGgKpPIWovpfpt0acDW6rSSIN1QJskQOSLh3T1s9XR84V4uMEXbbjSmubIj1onXYnP2egsOw20OZji8iG4PIH3eAmqLDXN2KIGj9lEWjQmOrcGkhagNReiOgEMPDkXS52J3bjQJNmexOR2DtyrHw1a3yuw).
