You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=649585cf07d74ce2b8338a9512abd708&_e=yjLbbsOtMup16qWi8NHc19YKb2uo1n9wFwhdMh3_aXqP2ojntL_2OoBoXRAY9P6x2VeKJstvGfCD0WHDoqgBntaP7Bn8ZC4w7lciciKHT6yUppSJP_-CZprMy5YdZvwf3mpFOM5QXAqyS1ubp-utUU5f3PereTkqZf2Lfpfg3J7FRFDFotmqHeqx30Qdtk2Z0_fdTU2C5g-9SVEAWeKLuBRNyiiJWSvOJsFlpM3-zdA3AdQhF-dSFfgfMyWTOHvDtk1OByhdxqXIc7da3BQtOWsGqfCyIfisZz1goLd7KxZ4z40o05QAWNUjgVQ_EFbk) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. name: Nikki Haley
subject: The American Dream
body:
Now, I just completed my THIRD debate, and we’re continuing to build a SURGE of momentum.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5be4th06lmbcmfvi46b927jqo6r3tr58v7h2o78_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs)
---

Friend, can I share something important with you?

Since I launched my campaign we've had more than 145 campaign stops, met with overflowing rooms of fired up voters across the country, and drawn a line in the sand on important policy issues.

Now, I just completed my **THIRD** debate, and we're continuing to build a **SURGE** of momentum.
But, we still have a lot of ground to cover in order to win the White House and save our country!

**[As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially to keep the MOMENTUM SURGING post debate.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvn79j124qdfvmasq83tmp873fbkiqnjoo94pdr0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs "As we continue to build a winning campaign, I want to remind you why I am running for President and why your support matters especially to keep the MOMENTUM SURGING post debate.")**

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkltehdmci4qh6d2s17bscfs446n9toc4l5isne0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs)
---

I'm a proud daughter of legal immigrants, a wife of a combat veteran, and a mother of two. I have watched the American Dream unfold before me.

_**But, with the Democrats in power, our future is slipping. **_

Right now, we have too many families paying too much for groceries; too many small businesses who can't afford rent, and too many big businesses getting taxpayer bailouts.

We have too much crime on our streets - too many drugs flooding our cities - and too few police and border patrol.

And from Joe Biden on down, our leaders put too much trust in big government and too little trust in the American people.

They have us spiraling toward socialism, with a new trillion-dollar spending bill every few months, and a national debt over 33 trillion dollars.

_**This is not the America I want to leave to my children! **_

I am running for President to save our country from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism. I aim to move America upward toward freedom and strength.

**[But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before 11:59 PM tonight?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgf7q2nvmmkdlk1snrecsqu8md18vb1rj7du9eu0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs "But, I need your help to make it happen. Can I count on you to chip in before 11:59 PM tonight?")**

_I can promise you, America is always worth fighting for._

As a brown girl, growing up in a black-and-white world, I saw the promise of America unfold before me.

As the proud wife of a combat veteran, I saw our people's deep love of freedom, and determination to defend it.

As governor, I saw our state move beyond hate and violence, and lift everyone in peace.

And as ambassador, I saw that America is still the standard.

Our moment is now - and our mission is clear.

**[Will you help me save our country and secure our future?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1uiups1g5f7sqoffd0d5lm4j1m025qhnehta2b0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs "Will you help me save our country and secure our future?")**

---
| | [CHIP IN NOW](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr2eq7vail68d7pbp1fi6oj3omfb53dglb9vebl0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs)
---

**[I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze76hoieocgojklvi2t88umc2r0fciu70a455730_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs "I appreciate your support more than you can imagine. If you can join me today by chipping in, it would mean so much to me.")**

Thank you for everything you do for our country.

---
My very best,

| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6pihbsdflif2g3obtals4vpnl0k5lo89b8q21cg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1l13qpg2gsi9le8sepicedbthks77bi2g5kjkjg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim8o36cph2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0i5acqr5jvos5vui9ir8iubo12mvrn520klmglg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim4o74cdh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

| Peter, If you’ve recently spent any time around teenagers, it’s clear that we have a widespread addiction problem on our hands. **Kids are hooked on social media** – and sometimes, it can have devastating consequences. Researchers have been looking at this problem for years, of course, and found convincing evidence that heavy social media use tends to make teenagers – especially girls – feel worse about their bodies and creates anxiety, depression and suicidal thoughts. But what’s even more shocking is that Meta (the parent company of Facebook and Instagram) has known about this problem for years, according to documents leaked by an internal whistleblower in 2021 [1] – **and they’ve apparently chosen to do virtually nothing about it since then.** **Finally, officials are stepping up to take action:** a group of 41 states and Washington, DC are now suing Meta to hold the company accountable for the youth mental health crisis caused by the addictive nature of Facebook and Instagram’s platforms. [2] Here at Accountable Tech, we couldn’t agree more. [**That’s why we’re asking you today to co-sign our letter of support to these attorneys general to let them know we approve of – and appreciate – their bold action.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T27b97967-e043-4406-9487-1d6259e98ffa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

But thanks to grassroots support, we convinced Meta to stop developing a version of Instagram for children under the age of 13. Peter – we can take on Big Tech and win. We’ve done it before and now we need to support these attorneys general. Big Tech has massive lobbying power and cash to throw around. | Friends:
I'm a Day One Trump supporter and today I'm releasing my Official 2024 Endorsement of Donald Trump for President.
I've worked on his campaigns and supported President Trump every step of the way, and I'm going to do everything I can to help him in 2024.
He's always had my full support, and now that the 2023 elections are over I'm looking ahead to 2024 and issuing my formal endorsement!
This country is falling apart under Joe Biden. Under Trump we would have had border security, energy dominance, and so much more.
And we wouldn't have had wars and conflict breaking out all over the world, from Hamas's horrible attack on Israel to the Ukraine invasion to China's attempts to become a totalitarian superpower.
It's time for all Republicans to unify and get behind Donald J. Trump.
Those of us who have been behind Trump all the way since the beginning know: he is the one person who will Make America Great Again.
Thank you,
Delegate John McGuire Father, Navy SEAL, Christian Conservative, Business Owner

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I want to share this with you
body:
Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35298%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NgVyU6KBAET99GC68djlRw&sysid=1)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it’s important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35299%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=24l0ooLjmCSDQejCEGCwqg&sysid=1 "Once youâ€TMve
finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help
me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35298%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NgVyU6KBAET99GC68djlRw&sysid=1)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family’s business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _“Don’t complain. Do something about it.” _

---
| | | So, that’s exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn’t easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35298%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NgVyU6KBAET99GC68djlRw&sysid=1)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn’t know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn’t have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the “kick-me” sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn’t know what hit them.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35298%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NgVyU6KBAET99GC68djlRw&sysid=1)
---

I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my **THIRD** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help us keep momentum STRONG!>>](https://secure.winred.com/team-stand-for-america/support-nikki-now-underdog-tv?sc=PRentalTV&recurring=true&utm_campaign=20231109_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1409265-2667&utm_medium=emailp&utm_source=WG-YAN2.103100&utm_content=20231109_i-want-to-share-this-with-you&ex_tid=20231109_WG-YAN2.103100_nikki-haley_t1409265-2667&utm_content=tv-yan-20231109&xunv=tv-yan-20231109 "It would mean a lot to me
if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the
strength of my campaign post-debate. >> ")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since the last debate!

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?>>](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35290%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=o%2f6aDYHmOeQF1XpimTJbiw&sysid=1 "Will you consider making a
one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [CHIP IN $5](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35291%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mBzb6Djm4WjhVDZcLCIJiA&sysid=1)
---
| | [CHIP IN $25](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35292%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pxMvXsbbZhfTBCPA2X1lVw&sysid=1)
---
| | [CHIP IN $50](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35293%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IM8NlzV0UbstFOlzxNkucQ&sysid=1)
---
| | [CHIP IN $150](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35294%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SnDCn6KaYXAntmOgYLDhZA&sysid=1)
---
| | [CHIP IN ANY OTHER AMOUNT](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35205%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=C8S7nbKQRm50bzBIhsVcmg&sysid=1)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I’m hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help to make it across the finish line- starting right now.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35206%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pbXNQo3UdlsRFl%2fo9MQSHw&sysid=1 " I need your help â€“
starting right now. ")**

Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35298%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NgVyU6KBAET99GC68djlRw&sysid=1)
---
Nikki Haley
---
| | | | |
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35207%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=v%2fYw7yDiuS1MHWwapCIfWA&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Merch")
---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35208%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=li%2b945KUqt1cmJ0ygf6zSw&sysid=1 "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35209%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6aUqozydRn26zypdu2fkZw&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35200%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Xu9Cj3f9fM1dvbrUTItyZw&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

subject: I want to share this with you
body:
Whether you’ve been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn’t be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1rgvfv9ubqa7cuei9oe8qean882slnl3mu6aasg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs)
---

Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjlcr0pf8nrqdlm9cfrccep8nre8amtqvt3albpg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztjnu6hbmt1rigihv0najut4jfafqtqvm49rcklo_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq9m9pfp6tuaj437edjqnbui7qac1v8flgt6mvp8_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvikk8qahg36r851m5hgqhvt3jr3g0ogvt0udspg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs)
---

Now, I just completed my **THIRD** debate, and I need a **SURGE** of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! **[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to help us keep momentum STRONG!>>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zo386rvls0tdqo05osibauogti90hutbralceopo_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since the last debate!

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9tf90ponbaffannanbkg4ra4lnf69lf0cmegeio_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim2or4cjh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

Working each day, our team continues to engage with the people of Illinois' 11th District and provide a clear vision of how we can better the lives all people back here at home.
Several people have asked how they can get involved. This Saturday at noon is the Kane County petition drive at 333 N Randall Road in St. Charles. Friend, it's Gov. Gavin Newsom. I'm fighting every day to win progress for families here in California. But to move our entire country forward and defeat the GOP extremists who are pushing us backward, we _need_ a strong Democratic majority in the Senate.
The truth is, I'm seriously concerned that we're about to hand control of the Senate to Mitch McConnell. **That's why I'm reaching out today to personally ask you to make a donation to help my friend Kirsten Gillibrand defend her must-win Senate seat. [_Please, will you donate now to help Kirsten save our Senate majority?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73061965/437272868/-2054302023?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4534-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTE5OWQ0My0wODdmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6KVntRA9t8aJ6fMMeNFbDeIIY6hNNTsUpQcU46oVREg=)**
If you've read almost anything about the 2024 elections, you know that Senate Democrats are facing an uphill battle.
**We have to defend a massive 23 seats across the country next fall — nearly half of the entire Democratic caucus._Republicans, on the other hand, only have to defend 11._** Our resources are going to be spread incredibly thin. That alone puts us at a massive fundraising disadvantage — not to mention the GOP's army of megadonors waiting in the wings. It's no wonder why election experts have called the Senate map a "GOP dream."
Listen, if Republicans retake power, everything that we care about will be at risk. We already know that key leaders within the GOP want to ban abortion nationwide, cut Social Security and Medicare, undo critical gun safety reforms, give ultra-wealthy Americans another massive tax break, and weaken our democracy even further. _And that's only what they've admitted out loud._
We simply cannot afford to let the GOP gain control of the Senate. But Kirsten is facing a tough battle. **Some might think New York is a safe blue state, but last year, Republicans nearly flipped the governorship in a damaging red wave. Now, following their best election cycle in decades, Republicans have their sights set on Kirsten's vital Senate seat.**
Friend, Kirsten isn't just my friend — she's a relentless leader for progress. We need her voice in the Senate.**And if she loses, it could hand control of the Senate to Mitch McConnell.** **[_So please, will you rush a donation right now to power Kirsten's grassroots campaign and defend our Democratic Senate majority? The third Republican debate went just as well as we knew it
would. We faced the nation, rose..

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os9tuYLiNN

Friend,

There is no clearer contrast between Joe Biden and the energy we
brought to the stage last night at the third Republican debate.
We just gave the nation a preview of what the nation will see in
the 2024 general election, and the response we're getting now is
unbelievable.

Now
is the time to take action. We put in the work standing up to the
challengers last night, but we are just getting started. We are
facing a chance to maximize our momentum TODAY if we step up and
make this victory a steppingstone to the next stage of our
campaign, but that means coming together to earn an unprecedented
show of support for our mission.

SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN NOW: DONATE $25 HERE

Now
that the nation has gotten another chance to see what we're
fighting for, here's what they know:

We WILL put an end to the absurd claims that men can get
pregnant.

We WILL throw every sexually-explicit material they've tried to
shove into our nation's elementary schools in the garbage-where
it belongs.

We WILL go straight to the southern border, ARMED, and leave
Mexican drug cartel members trying to bring thousands of pounds
of fentanyl near young Americans STONE COLD DEAD.

We WILL fire every bureaucrat that siphons off tax-payer dollars
to fund ineffective, corrupt, useless agencies.

We WILL hold federal leaders accountable for the harm they've
done to adult Americans and the futures of American children.

We WILL restore our American dominance and strength from our
military to our manufacturing, to our energy sector.

We WILL END our toxic, abusive relationship with China, and
declare our economic independence from foreign adversaries.

After last night's debate, we are one step closer to slashing the
outrageous cost of living that Biden has imposed on average
Americans, stripping the woke absurdity out of the lives of
children, and reinstating our dominance as a nation so our future
is as proud, independent, and free as our past.

We're doing everything we can to defeat this failing radical Left
for good, but they've seen how strong we are and what we will
achieve, and now we have a giant target on our back. It will take
more than one donation to defeat Joe Biden-we MUST NOT let up.

<<
Help me continue to fight back by sending in a monthly donation
to my campaign here >>

PLEDGE ANY AMOUNT

We
have a long road ahead and these stakes are too high to risk
falling behind. I need you to step up on this team, and I believe
that you will. Click here to send in a quick donation to help
fund our fight for a free American future.

Yours in Freedom,

Ron
DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

On that debate stage, I hope you saw in me the candidate who delivers the TRUTH. That an American revival is real and achievable.

| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0bhcg07ob40l3af1nh5cb545r97kp6v2uoluosg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)

**Fellow American,**

Another debate down, and the contrast between the other candidates and myself could not be more clear. We can continue to be a party that loses and lacks direction OR we can start taking on the dishonest media and the establishment marching us toward World War III. _**Nothing can stand in our way if we do this and unite under one flag and identity.**_

My direction is the **TRUTH.**

I’m running for President of these United States – not for foreign countries across the globe. The neocons of the past spent trillions, killed billions, and in the process profited from creating global chaos. _**You have my word, I will keep us out of World War III.**_

>From securing our border, declaring independence from Communist China, and believing in an America ready to answer the challenges of the future, I’m ready to be a leader who restores the ideals our country was founded on.

[**Can you help me keep this momentum going and continue to show your support for the TRUTH?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgv2jv58gmkeelhrs61gt72h4dugh6jvubobavk8_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)

HACKS **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr4pts2q4g7pmgq6m2vmr334hn84a0id12aa61tg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)
---

It’s time for a new generation of leadership. The American people deserve a government that doesn’t lie to us – about the origin of Covid, about Ukraine, about Hunter Biden, about Jan 6. and the Nashville transgender school shooter’s manifesto. We can handle the **TRUTH.**

[**Fellow American, give me liberty and give me TRUTH.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7m41laqp6fv43o0n6rgkbknfalhjq5rcfubmi5g_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)

**Super PAC puppets. Politicians who are more interested in getting rich than serving the interests of the American people.** That's the system we need to break away from if we will ever get the spirit of America thriving again. Republicans or Democrats, it doesn't matter. The minute we can all stop playing the game the establishment has set for us – we can achieve great things together.

The American revival where we take pride in our national identity – founded on family, faith, patriotism, and hard work – is achievable. The great American dream is real. The America First 2.0 agenda my campaign is running on, belongs to _**you.**_

On that debate stage, I hope you saw in me the candidate who brings those ideas to life. I have laid out my plans for our national revival and took the attacks from the establishment hacks. Fellow American, with you on my side, I know that we cannot be beaten. [**Please consider a contribution and let’s get a a victory movement in 2024.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr9rbnkj0e6jgk0r0lp2rqaq4l13b2cnt5dld678_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)

Thank you,

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeg372ujq86g3h165vt1cn3r74hblivu9ethik0g_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** VICTORY MOMENT **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z14q3cuii4fleme0r5hq1npui2ho2d4834m13d90_rp22sh2s8i66p74slimepj2c5h2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Dear Fellow Patriot,

Are you sick to death of watching our Second Amendment freedoms suffer under a President who has painted you as an enemy of the state?

Do you feel like gun owners are being systematically targeted by the government?

_If you don 't, you should._

Because Biden's ATF will stop at nothing until they have every single gun, gun owner, and firearm distributor registered and marked.

**_They 're already harassing local gun stores, busting down their doors in a SWAT team fashion_**.

**_It 's only a matter of time before they come for every last one of us_**.

And now, to top it all off, Biden has created another bureaucratic agency with a singular mission: dismantling the Second Amendment.

A **_super-ATF_** , if you will.

**They hate us. They hate our way of life. They hate everything we stand for. And they 're trying to make our lives a living Hell**.

I've had enough.

And so should you.

_So how about we give the liberal gun-grabbers something else to whine about?_

**_I 'm proud to announce one of the largest giveaway we've ever done_**.

**[As a"thank you" to you for your tireless efforts, we're giving one lucky winner a 2023 Toyota Tacoma TRD Pro AND a custom cerakoted LWRC IC DI rifle in our 2A Technical Giveaway](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq93ic697n4vq6ltm91hnacmfefk40gtcu51ig30_rp22sh2s8i66p74slim1oj2c9h2bs)**!

That's right - this **_2A Technical Giveaway_ is over _$65,000_ in value**.

This 4x4 double-cab truck consists of a 3.5L V6 engine with 278 horsepower and a five-foot bed.

**_This thing is a BEAST_**.

It also has:
* Multi-Terrain Monitor (MTM) * with camera
* Black TRD Pro leather-trimmed front seats with 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat
* LED headlights with sequential turn signals, Daytime Running Lights (DRL), Rigid Industries® * fog lights, black sport bezels
* Blind Spot Monitor (BSM) * with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert (RCTA) *
* Smart Key System

And so much more!

If that weren't enough, this giveaway also includes a top-of-the-line **LWRC IC DI rifle in 5.56 (which Biden is trying to BAN)** , with:
* Aimpoint T2 red dot on a Reptilia mount
* Arisaka weapon light and mount
* Blue Force Gear sling
* Custom cerakote finish

Again, this is one of the largest giveaways we've ever done, and it's all thanks to YOU, Fellow Patriot.

This is our way of showing our appreciation to you for all the hard work you've put in over the past year.

**_Because of you, we 've secured MULTIPLE recent wins like_**: \- A preliminary injunction against the ATF's illegal ban on Forced Reset Triggers \- Halting the ATF's pistol brace ban for NAGR members \- Stopping the New Mexico Governor from banning open and conceal carry in Albuquerque Those are just a few from the past month!

But the work continues.

We will not rest until we see the Second Amendment stop being treated like a second-class right.

Again, I just wanted to say thank you one last time for all of your hard work, and you're going to want to enter to win your **2023 Toyota Tacoma TRD Pro** AND a **custom cerakoted LWRC IC DI rifle** in our **2A Technical Giveaway** as quickly as possible!

God bless you, God bless America, and God bless our cherished freedoms.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President

The [**latest episode**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=cce65ad72b&e=567664f14c) of No Doubt About It with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti isn't just another post-election analysis – it's a deep dive into the surprises and strategies that are reshaping our political conversation.

➡ [**STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=952d0485ec&e=567664f14c)
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=a922c25409&e=567664f14c)

In this episode, we team up with renowned political strategist Jay McCleskey to recap the recent election results. **You might be surprised to discover that Republicans performed better in Albuquerque city council races than many expected.

** On the flip side, Republicans faced challenges in other national races, particularly concerning the sensitive issue of abortion. We delve into what Republicans can do to move beyond the abortion debate and refocus voters on their strong suits, such as the economy and border security.
| [STREAM EPISODE 51 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=8349516655&e=567664f14c)
---
We wrap up the episode by dissecting the latest Republican presidential debate, where Nikki Haley didn't hold back calling Vivek Ramaswamy "scum." We breakdown the fireworks and what the impacts may be going forward.
| [STREAM EPISODE 51 NOW](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=9f43c6415e&e=567664f14c)

| | | Donald Trump appears to be losing his mind, yet the media is largely ignoring it. Of late, Trump has repeatedly matched world leaders with the wrong countries, misplaced countries on maps, and even confused North Korea with China. He's increasingly speaking in non-sequiturs, rambling more than ever, and devolving into [outright nonsense](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04898c30-a832-4774-bcd5-dfcfa9372d0d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T442eec63-6261-4fc4-b114-2cb98bcb4b58/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **[And yet, the same media that obsesses over the tiniest misstep by Biden largely ignores these glaring ones by Trump.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tebb3f427-143a-4613-af69-2a5c282a86b6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) ** This isn't just Trump being Trump -- already bad enough -- this is Trump having serious memory and mental problems, ones which make him even more dangerous. And it's getting worse. And the media needs to stop ignoring it. name: Tom Fitton
subject: Our Last Line of Defense Against Voter Fraud!
body:
The fact is that honest elections in America are under attack from the Biden administration and the radical Left, who are on a long-term campaign to destroy our election safeguards...and make it easier to steal elections in 2024 and beyond!

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch members have helped us _an historic leadership role_ in forcing states to follow federal election laws that are our _last line of_ _defense_ against voter fraud and corrupt elections.
But the fact is that honest elections in America are under attack from the Biden administration and the radical Left, _who are on a long-term campaign to destroy our election safeguards_..._and make it easier to steal elections in 2024 and beyond_!
That's a bold statement I know, but I promise you, it's no exaggeration.
**[And it is why I am asking you to make a special contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

Since 2012, we've been filing lawsuits and winning victories in federal courts in states including **California, Colorado, Florida, Indiana, Kentucky, North Carolina** , **Ohio** and **Pennsylvania** to help ensure honest elections, which is so important _to preserving our constitutional republic in this time of crisis_.

And, _right now,_ we are preparing to warn additional states that they need to begin to clean their voter rolls, or expect a Judicial Watch lawsuit!

I am proud of Judicial Watch's unique and essential work keeping our elections clean and honest, and _helping make certain that only eligible American citizens are allowed to vote_.

Looking ahead to a presidential election next year, you can be sure we are tightly focused on fighting back against the Left's _radical and reckless measures like_...

* Unsecured mail-in ballots using (often highly) inaccurate voter rolls
* Ballot harvesting
* Abolition of voter ID requirements

Our work is vitally important...and [it is _expensive_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580).

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

Suing state governments, with their deep pockets and big legal budgets, is not only costly...it is time consuming. From start to finish, our election law litigation can take years. We always strive to squeeze the most out of our funds because we know that it is careful spending that keeps our clean election mission intact. _That 's very important_.

But we rely on the financial support patriotic Americans like you to carry forward all our work...and as we prepare for 2024, we really need you back on the Judicial Watch team!

Thanks to the commitment of our supporters, we will always find ways to confront corrupt politicians in both parties and "permanent government" bureaucrats who have contempt for the rule of law...especially our election laws.

Your decision to help us with an additional tax-deductible contribution today will make it easier for us to respond with full force to challenges to the rule of law we are facing today... _especially the radical Left 's efforts to subvert honest elections in 2024._

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

We are now the national leader in protecting the integrity of our elections. And you have my personal pledge if you will join with us today that with your support again today, we will _continue_ to be the most effective independent and effective government watchdog in Washington.

**Your contribution now will also help us expose public corruption, fight for the people 's right to know and hold lawless politicians and unscrupulous public officials of both political parties accountable.**

You can be assured that your tax-deductible gift will help advance all our investigative, educational and legal activities. **[So please donate today**.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65743&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

On behalf of all of us at Judicial Watch, I thank you in advance for your support.

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

The other party should not be deciding the outcome of of primaries. If you say you are Republican, they you register as such. There is also SB147 in the senate which mimics for the Most part HB208. The only difference between the two bills is when you must register by, either 30 day prior or 90 days prior. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I want you to know the truth
body:
Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z94o19grif6amquh9fmb9iksdjb524sdqqddl1no_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs)
---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zg2fb6kmbpc5aootcr57su84i5q0vb0eksimssq0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5m91rplbs2ss2o0r4ehet8l613bag647htm8pm0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk3qn2jvs4fiqmcsm04snv2vrv2rv3crt7320be8_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6tj93nq1ge65odurr42cntfid0j09rg9cjn03hg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3j7ckac5ahgq1hbild5u9egb4na50gbetrfuei8_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the of OUR movement?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkvqge0sdp16n6did1aj8vlm9otjdivst4sfosjg_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdvi8grjund9i0brfqjs297old8p7mh0nv8k3k8o_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5oepi2gbh72uteqckvp2qtvkghgfc9hbv4n8tag_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zghl95f5l1d2t1pvlmi7flh82379kngghon358vo_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs)
---
Nikki Haley

---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z3l2d2pgtihvg2qsa2fgijllg1qjd1rjkkvl61co_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ziq2k4qhd74atb9h4ud9ffauiki1p0d2t9qb47c8_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7pdp60hksogpfae9gb0dropfp05g3becjdtgdh0_rp22sh2s8i66p74slhm8o72chh2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

body:
It’s up to us to keep putting in the work towards a future free from gun violence
#

We’re at a turning point for our movement.
While we’ve accomplished so much over the past ten years in the fight to end gun violence, there are imminent threats to our progress.
The Supreme Court will be deciding two cases this term that will have massive implications for public safety. One decision will determine whether or not people subject to domestic violence restraining orders can possess guns. The other will decide whether or not the federal ban on bump stocks will remain in place.
We currently have a gun safety Senate majority, but it’s incredibly slim. Our newly elected House speaker is an extremist who has made it clear that his loyalty lies with the NRA—not with keeping our communities safe from violence.
A year from now, we’ll have just elected a new Congress. It’s up to us to put in the work now to ensure that when we wake up on November 6, 2024, we'll know that we did **_everything**_ we could to fill both chambers of Congress with gun safety champions.

name: Shift WA
subject: Our X “fight” with a Democrat Senator
body:
Democrat State Senator Marko Liias told the world of his plans for jet-setting to Finland to - in his words - "get inspired to reduce traffic fatalities." | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62454671:sRyGuLiNq:m:1:2610672541:C5382573DC085BBAA4CEC9FC45CD2C38:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends,

Democrat State Senator Marko Liias told the world of his plans for jet-setting to Finland to - in his words - "get inspired to reduce traffic fatalities." Of course, his holiday trip over to Europe will be covered by the taxpayer dollars, so Shift thought it deserved some coverage.

That's right - your taxpayer dollars will cover a state senator's overseas trip for the purpose of "inspiration." And he's planning on taking a bunch of state bureaucrats and other legislators with him on the junket. Never mind that Liias' boondoggle could easily be handled with a Zoom call.

This from a senator who, along with his fellow Leftists, claims to be very concerned about climate change and everyone else's carbon footprints. Unfortunately, as is so often the case with Democrats, this is a clear case of their "do as I say, not as I do" hypocrisy.

We here at Shift WA have been at the forefront of drawing attention to Sen. Liias' wasteful trip - and highlighting the hypocrisy of it all. And, it appears that Liias isn't too happy about all the subsequent negative attention coming his way.

Liias tweeted the following Wednesday:
For the good senator, anyone who dares to criticize him, or his taxpayer-funded trip overseas, is an "extremist" of some sort. It was obvious that Sen. Liias was attempting to smear us, so we responded to him saying:
Liias responded saying:
When called out for his irresponsible behavior with taxpayer dollars, Sen. Liias apparently has plenty of time on his hands for name-calling and pathetic comebacks. Typical of the Left.

Plain and simple, we here at Shift WA have decided on a mission to encourage state officials to refrain from going on such a wasteful taxpayer-funded international trip that could easily be handled via a Zoom call. Clearly, we are having success in garnering public attention to the issue or Sen. Liias wouldn't be so peeved about the backlash he is receiving.

[ **But we need your help to continue highlighting how Democrats in Olympia so often waste taxpayer dollars on extremely unnecessary international trips - and the hypocrisy of it all.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62454672:sRyGuLiNq:m:1:2610672541:C5382573DC085BBAA4CEC9FC45CD2C38:r)

**[Will you help us by contributing $100, $50, or even $25 today?](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62454672:sRyGuLiNq:m:1:2610672541:C5382573DC085BBAA4CEC9FC45CD2C38:r)**

The truth is, we are fell short of our fundraising goal last month. [**We need your help right now to ensure we can continue our work of highlighting hypocrisy and holding politicians accountable.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62454672:sRyGuLiNq:m:1:2610672541:C5382573DC085BBAA4CEC9FC45CD2C38:r)

[ **Please consider contributing today.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62454672:sRyGuLiNq:m:1:2610672541:C5382573DC085BBAA4CEC9FC45CD2C38:r)

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62454673:sRyGuLiNq:m:1:2610672541:C5382573DC085BBAA4CEC9FC45CD2C38:r)

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

Moments like this make me especially proud to be an Ohioan – and to represent my state in the Senate. We’ve seen midwestern states show up again and again to protect reproductive freedom – including in Michigan last year. Michigan might be our rivals on the football field, but I’m happy to be joining them in the family of states that have protected abortion access. And now that we've protected abortion access in Ohio, I promise you that I'll continue to work every day to make sure women’s rights to make their own health care decisions are also protected nationwide. But here's the deal: I'm up for reelection, and I'm running against three anti-abortion extremists – all of whom would support a national abortion ban. In addition, our neighbors up north have an open Senate seat to defend, and every Republican in the race supports a national abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest. The latest polls show that both my race and Elissa Slotkin’s race are neck and neck, and our Democratic Senate majority is up for grabs. If we’re going to win these key races and protect abortion rights from Mitch McConnell, we need your grassroots support. So today, as we celebrate this victory, I'm personally asking you to help me keep up our momentum: In solidarity, Sherrod Brown PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN P.O. Box 4145 East Lansing, MI 48826

In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Bill Greiner, founder of Primary Bank. Bill shares his story of attending Brandeis University, stumbling into a career in investment management, and starting a hedge fund at the age of 25. He goes on to share how 9/11 changed his outlook on life and led him to pursue a more balanced life that took him into real estate investing and development, the restaurant business, and eventually to even starting a bank. Bill offers sage advice for all of us seeking to succesfully navigate uncertainty: go with your gut, and if you're not sure, ask for help!

| Dear Friend,

**Mississippi is now surrounded by states that have either implemented education freedom (Arkansas), or are moving towards it (Alabama, Louisiana). **Why aren’t we?
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=b01498ee44&e=5703353baa)
---
_Click on the image above to reserve your place_
| Corey DeAngelis, one of the leading advocates for education freedom and Fox News contributor, is coming to Jackson to talk about the benefits of giving parents control over their tax dollars. ******Corey will be****explaining how Arkansas-type reform could work for our state, driving up standards and giving every family opportunities that today only rich people enjoy. **

Perhaps the most exciting innovation in education freedom in our state this year is the establishment of ACE scholarships. At this event, David Olson of ACE Scholarships will explain how ACE scholarships work – and introduce a young student that has benefited from the program. Come and listen to what a life-changing opportunity school choice brings for Mississippi families!

#
Friends -
Today, we are proud to endorse Angela Alsobrooks for Maryland’s open U.S. Senate Seat.
Angela is a lifelong Marylander, mom, former prosecutor, and Prince George’s County Executive. And now, she's running for the Senate to create new jobs, bring down the cost of living, improve our healthcare system, and strengthen our kids' education.
[**If you are ready to give Angela your support, please use this link to split a contribution between her campaign for Senate and The Long Run today.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-alsobrooks-split.edwx-i&refcode=em231109-1-t2&t=1&akid=4990%2E196590%2EEdhpvh)

Inspired by her great-grandmother’s words, Angela devoted her life to public service so she would not sit on the sidelines but “go farther and do better.”
She began her public service journey 13 years ago in her lifelong home of Prince George’s County, Maryland. She fought to develop new economic opportunities, improve the health, safety, and security of our communities, and strengthen our education system.
Angela is a trailblazer and has the experience to represent and lead Maryland in the Senate. She served as County Executive, Prince George's County's first full-time domestic violence prosecutor, and became the youngest and first woman to be elected Prince George’s County State’s Attorney.
If elected, Angela will make history by becoming the State’s first Black Senator and the third Black woman ever elected to the Senate.
Angela is running for Senate to be a voice for families like the ones she grew up with and has worked for throughout her life and we are going to help her cross the finish line next November.

clean_body: Friends - Today, we are proud to endorse Angela Alsobrooks for Maryland’s open U.S. Senate Seat. Angela is a lifelong Marylander, mom, former prosecutor, and Prince George’s County Executive. And now, she's running for the Senate to create new jobs, bring down the cost of living, improve our healthcare system, and strengthen our kids' education. Inspired by her great-grandmother’s words, Angela devoted her life to public service so she would not sit on the sidelines but “go farther and do better.” She began her public service journey 13 years ago in her lifelong home of Prince George’s County, Maryland. She fought to develop new economic opportunities, improve the health, safety, and security of our communities, and strengthen our education system. Angela is a trailblazer and has the experience to represent and lead Maryland in the Senate. She served as County Executive, Prince George's County's first full-time domestic violence prosecutor, and became the youngest and first woman to be elected Prince George’s County State’s Attorney. If elected, Angela will make history by becoming the State’s first Black Senator and the third Black woman ever elected to the Senate. Angela is running for Senate to be a voice for families like the ones she grew up with and has worked for throughout her life and we are going to help her cross the finish line next November. If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will be split between Angela Alsobrooks and The Long Run immediately: It’s leaders like Angela who will help us protect our Democratic Senate majority and our democracy. Thank you in advance for your contribution. The team at the Long Run
