URGENT! Ohio Precinct Strategy! | | | [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a72ca90bb2&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
|

**Since Issues 1 & 2 have been settled (at least for now), what are the critical initiatives and important dates for grassroots, conservative, Ohioans to know about? And where do these many initiatives need your help? That's the topic of this communication.**

---
| | |
**THE OHIO PRECINCT STRATEGY**

**CANDIDATES NEEDED!

NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY!**

---
|
If you haven't heard of the "precinct strategy" it's imperative you learn what it is and how it can be a big part of taking back our county, state, and communities from corrupt insiders.

Ohio's political parties have an organization, codified in the Ohio Revised Code (ORC), that provides for 88 county parties and 1 state party for each of major political parties (Republican & Democrat).

Every precinct (or in some counties every ward & township) has an elected, unpaid, representative on their County Central Committee (CCC). These are the lowest-level elected offices in America, and a great way for average Americans to have an impact on how we are governed. All politics truly is local, right down to the precinct level. And the commitment is typically no more than a few hours a calendar quarter.

The Ohio Precinct Strategy was formed to help Ohioans understand Ohio's political structure and identify grassroots candidates to run for these seats. The only qualification you need is to be an Ohio registered voter. It's an easy 12-step process and in many cases if you just go vote for yourself you'll be elected, as many of these seats go unfilled and there is often no opponent in these races.

To learn more, watch this short video that explains CCCs:

On Rumble:

[https://rumble.com/v3stw1m-introduction-to-the-precinct-strategy-1080.html](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=330e413310&e=5c740fa3e2)

On YouTube:

[https://youtu.be/q43xIxROVHg?si=ncvqJw2jFmmu0Ebf](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=4d7bf79732&e=5c740fa3e2)

**DECEMBER 20, 2023 IS THE DEADLINE TO FILE TO RUN FOR THESE POSITIONS!**

If after watching the video you are interested in running, please go to:

[https://www.ohioprecinctstrategy.org](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=17223085c3&e=5c740fa3e2)

There, you can register, find more information on filing to run, how to run and win, and what you can do once in office. We also have people across the state who can provide any help & information you need.

If you have any questions, feel free to call Mark Pukita at 614-499-0599 (c) and have a chat. You can text or email him too: mark@mark4ohio.com

**REMEMBER: THE FILING DEADLINE TO RUN FOR YOUR COUNTY CENTRAL COMMITTEE IS DECEMBER 20, 2023, SO LET'S GET GOING!**

---
| |
**A NEW CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS!**

---
|
The grassroots, conservative community in Ohio is coming together into a coordinated, united, focused, voter bloc that can no longer be ignored. It's time to take the next steps to solidify a durable, multi-generational, growing movement. To do this, we need volunteers to help with a few activities. Here's the newest need we've never posted before:

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=096238b71d&e=5c740fa3e2)

We're kicking-off what must be a massive voter registration drive across Ohio in churches, at gun shows, and in other places & at other events where we have the best chance of reaching eligible but non-registered (ENR) grassroots voters. This is imperative to improve our likelihood of winning future elections. If you have an interest in being part of a team that develops a plan to make this a reality, go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=38bd6bdc86&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill in the form with your contact information. We'll be back to you in a week or two once we have a critical mass of volunteers. Thank you!

---
|
---
| |
**PRE-ORDER "SOUTH OF 60" PROMOTIONAL ITEMS******

---
|
The "South of 60" project is a working group of OhioFAN in partnership with GFI. Its goal is to recruit like-minded "South of 60" individuals to join, maintain, and further spread the message of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness in Ohio. Our movement needs younger blood, and lots of it!

Like we've done with both Issues 1, we're going to use car signs & bumper stickers on rolling billboards (vehicles) across Ohio to promote this effort. Interested viewers can scan a QR code that takes them to a form where they can provide contact information and survey responses so the "South of 60" team can get them plugged-into either issues groups (like schools & kids or election integrity) or freedom groups around the state (or both). The goal of "South of 60" is to grow both of these constituencies so we bring more people into our "tent". You can access the survey [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8ea0741ea8&e=5c740fa3e2).

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a0dc17341a&e=5c740fa3e2)

To order items to help us in this effort, at cost, go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1b5101feca&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill in the requested information.

You'll be hearing more about this effort over the next month. We wanted those of you who are "first-movers" to have the opportunity to get these signs "rolling"! Thank you!

---

**CONTINUING CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS!**

---
|
We need volunteers to help with other activities. Here's what we need:

##
[CRITICAL: CHURCH & PASTOR (OHIO) DATABASE DEVELOPMENT DATA ENTRY](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8b0528a8bc&e=5c740fa3e2)
As part of our efforts to defeat November's Issue 1, we need help organizing a pan-Ohio, church & pastor database. We need volunteers who we will direct to websites where church & pastor data can be found. Volunteers will enter what they find into an online form we've developed that automatically builds a spreadsheet for us. There is no spreadsheet experience necessary. This is a data entry or data "cut & paste" activity. It's essential we have this contact information so our army of phone callers can contact pastors about defeating Issue 1. Anyone can do this!

To volunteer for this CRITICAL need, please go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=04717e9125&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill in the form. Someone will be back to you very quickly! Thank you!

##
[SOCIAL MEDIA TEAM](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8e046accaf&e=5c740fa3e2)
GFI, together with OhioFAN and OhioFAN's member organizations, are building a social media powerhouse. We envision having a world-class, social media team, who develop messaging and messages, post original content developed by the team, and amplify, through sharing, the "reach" of our messages. This will be a well-organized, well-managed, team of volunteers working to get out our messages of freedom, small government, self-responsibility, sanctity of life, and constitutional order, to name a few.

To put your hat in the ring to be part of this team, please go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=ddfd1acdb6&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill out the quick survey. Someone will be back to you soon. Thank you!

#

[RADIO CALLERS "BUREAU"](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=d977bfaeab&e=5c740fa3e2) -and- [LETTERS TO EDITOR & OPED WRITERS "BUREAU"](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=7d0d4617f4&e=5c740fa3e2)
We're developing two statewide working groups to use the legacy media to ouR advantage. We're looking for volunteers who can (and will) write & speak (call-in radio). The writing will be letters to the editor and opinion pieces ("Op-Ed"). The speaking will be calling into talk radio shows. This is a statewide effort we're already building-out across Ohio.

We're going to work on crafting consistent messaging across the state, so this will be a team effort - you won't be on your own! If you'd like to explore this volunteer opportunity, please fill out one (or both?) of the forms linked below. Thank you!

| | Friend, I'm feeling emotional as I write this email to you. Michigan legislators just passed a 100 percent clean energy standard by 2040 as part of a whole package of critical climate bills.

For the people of Michigan, this will:

☑️ Lower household energy costs
☑️ Slash climate pollution
☑️ Create tens of thousands of good-paying jobs
☑️ Improve grid reliability during extreme weather events

This is a huge victory for the Midwest, one that will truly improve lives and livelihoods.

**But it's also a reminder of what we're up against in the broader fight for climate action.**

These bills faced intense opposition from fossil fuel interests and private utilities like DTE. Their lobbying led to compromises, and while we will work to address these in future legislation, it goes to show just how much still needs to be done to **stop utilities from using ratepayer funds to lobby against climate action.**

Evergreen is gearing up to fight dirty utilities and get their bad influence out of climate policy—**will you help us?**

**In Case You Missed It:**
**“[Christie] Had The Most Consistent Debate, Start To Finish... A-”

** _“One would think that answering the moderator’s question is an important part of the debating process, but most candidates consider it optional. Not Christie.”_
[CNN](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=54cfa560f6&e=d0a9afa930)
Todd Graham, Professor of debate at Southern Illinois University
November 9, 2023
“I know, right. I didn’t see it coming either. The former New Jersey governor was the biggest surprise. During the debate, I thought Chris Christie was doing well, but it wasn’t until after the debate when examining my notes that I noticed something peculiar. The Christie debating trademark was missing. Usually, his moments of brilliance are –— as Senator Tim Scott would probably understand — sandwich-boarded by acts of self-flagellation. But that didn’t happen this time. Christie eliminated his errors and in so doing, had the most consistent debate, start to finish.
“One would think that answering the moderator’s question is an important part of the debating process, but most candidates consider it optional. Not Christie. Yes, he could have been much stronger with his first answer on how he differentiated himself from Donald Trump, but unlike others onstage, at least he mentioned Trump’s legal issues.
“Christie was on point with direct answers from there on out. He was flat-out great in justifying our support of Ukraine, a debate Christie can win against anyone. On other topics, Christie taught me that nuclear subs are our best deterrent of China and they should be upgraded/ built before other ships. Plus, I liked his answer on inflation – on why energy drives most prices, so our energy policy should be our focus to address inflation....
A-”

-###-

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

| | Hey Peter, before you head off for the long weekend, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the importance of Veterans Day and share my vision for supporting our veterans as we look to the future. Veterans Day is a time to show our deep appreciation for those who have served our country with brave and unwavering dedication. Their sacrifices have been instrumental in preserving our freedoms and way of life, and it is our duty to honor their commitment. Unfortunately, when they return home, many face new burdens. In Oregon, there are more than 265,000 Veterans, of which approximately 1,460 are homeless and 7.7% live in poverty. We need to do more to support our veterans as they transition to civilian life and beyond. **In Congress I would advocate for policies that address the needs of Oregonian veterans, active-duty military, and their families.** This includes improving their access to health care including mental health services, ensuring they have opportunities for education and employment, and supporting their success when they return home. Together, we can ensure they receive the resources and recognition they've earned. clean_body: Investing in a brighter future for Oregon by supporting our veterans and their families. | | | | Hey Peter, before you head off for the long weekend, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on the importance of Veterans Day and share my vision for supporting our veterans as we look to the future. Veterans Day is a time to show our deep appreciation for those who have served our country with brave and unwavering dedication. Their sacrifices have been instrumental in preserving our freedoms and way of life, and it is our duty to honor their commitment. Unfortunately, when they return home, many face new burdens. In Oregon, there are more than 265,000 Veterans, of which approximately 1,460 are homeless and 7.7% live in poverty. We need to do more to support our veterans as they transition to civilian life and beyond. In Congress I would advocate for policies that address the needs of Oregonian veterans, active-duty military, and their families. This includes improving their access to health care including mental health services, ensuring they have opportunities for education and employment, and supporting their success when they return home. Together, we can ensure they receive the resources and recognition they've earned. Your support will help us take significant steps toward fulfilling this vision. Peter — Over 13 years ago, the Supreme Court decided _Citizens United v. FEC_ in a case that would forever impact our elections and democracy. Shady outside interests now have an outsized influence on elections simply because they have the most money. Because of the _Citizens United_ decision, megamillionaires, billionaires, and special interests can spend practically whatever they want to influence voters. Wisconsin’s Senate race is a prime example of just that — **with megamillionaire Eric Hovde willing to spend tens of millions of his own personal fortune to tilt the scales and flip this seat red.** As a vocal supporter of overturning _Citizens United_ and getting shady special interests out of our elections, I’m no stranger to being up against outside money. Special interest groups have made me one of their top targets to unseat. **But no amount of money spent to defeat me will keep me silent on this issue, and I’m counting on you to join me in speaking out:** **[Dark money groups have been undermining American democracy for well over a decade now, and our communities have paid the price. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73093508/437365334/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MmNkYTgyNS0yZTdmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1-JaI9PB3PBa5xbH5vNisdIf1j07jjUBn3hJf-IA2bs=&emci=c30d95af-7d7e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=72cda825-2e7f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=9494239)

| | I represent 48,000 veterans. **Ahead of Veterans' Day Weekend, I want to share that it is an honor and a privilege to represent the women and men in uniform of Washington's 2nd Congressional District in Congress.** Our service members exemplify patriotism, honor, and selflessness, as they willingly place themselves in harm's way to protect the values and principles that underpin our democracy. Their unwavering commitment and resilience in the face of danger and adversity are nothing short of remarkable, and we must continuously acknowledge the sacrifices they make on behalf of our country. **Service members and their families bear tremendous burdens: extended deployments, frequent relocations, and the enduring uncertainty that accompanies military life all impose hardships that often go unnoticed.** In Congress, I remain committed to supporting Veterans, active duty military, and their loved ones. It is my privilege to champion policies and initiatives that bolster the well-being, health care, and benefits of our service members and their families, including:
* **IVF and Reproductive health care:** As it stands, our military's health insurance coverage does not extend to many forms of reproductive assistance, including in vitro fertilization and surrogacy. I have been working with fellow lawmakers to expand the services included for veterans trying to start a family, and provide assistance for service members seeking to freeze their eggs or sperm prior to deployment.
* **Averting a Government Shutdown:** without the continuing resolution passed back in October, 79,000 military personnel in Washington state _alone_ would have to work without pay — right now, I am working to ensure we can keep our government operational beyond the upcoming deadline.
* **Housing** : Last year, I supported a bill to provide more than a half-billion dollars in VA Supportive Housing. These funds have been used nationwide to serve veterans. But in our district alone, these funds helped more than 420 veterans find housing and access case management and clinical services.

clean_body: The resilience and strength exhibited by service members and military families is remarkable. | | | | I represent 48,000 veterans. Ahead of Veterans' Day Weekend, I want to share that it is an honor and a privilege to represent the women and men in uniform of Washington's 2nd Congressional District in Congress. Our service members exemplify patriotism, honor, and selflessness, as they willingly place themselves in harm's way to protect the values and principles that underpin our democracy. Their unwavering commitment and resilience in the face of danger and adversity are nothing short of remarkable, and we must continuously acknowledge the sacrifices they make on behalf of our country. Service members and their families bear tremendous burdens: extended deployments, frequent relocations, and the enduring uncertainty that accompanies military life all impose hardships that often go unnoticed. In Congress, I remain committed to supporting Veterans, active duty military, and their loved ones. It is my privilege to champion policies and initiatives that bolster the well-being, health care, and benefits of our service members and their families, including: IVF and Reproductive health care: As it stands, our military's health insurance coverage does not extend to many forms of reproductive assistance, including in vitro fertilization and surrogacy. I have been working with fellow lawmakers to expand the services included for veterans trying to start a family, and provide assistance for service members seeking to freeze their eggs or sperm prior to deployment. Averting a Government Shutdown: without the continuing resolution passed back in October, 79,000 military personnel in Washington state alone would have to work without pay — right now, I am working to ensure we can keep our government operational beyond the upcoming deadline. Housing : Last year, I supported a bill to provide more than a half-billion dollars in VA Supportive Housing. These funds have been used nationwide to serve veterans. But in our district alone, these funds helped more than 420 veterans find housing and access case management and clinical services. Supporting Survivors of Sexual Assault: I cosponsored a piece of bipartisan legislation that would help protect our U.S. Coast Guard Academy cadets from being disciplined for minor collateral misconduct (think: underaged drinking, or violating curfew) when reporting sexual assault. That way, survivors can come forward about their experience without fear. Addressing Exposure to Toxic Substances: I supported legislation to ensure veterans exposed to burn pits and toxic substances (think Agent Orange and PFAS) can access the care they need. Transportation : I am working to ensure veterans who live in rural communities can easily get to their medical appointments. I will continue to advocate for robust resources for service members and their families as they make unsung sacrifices to address the various challenges that confront our nation. To our active duty service members, veterans, and their loved ones: thank you for your dedicated commitment to our nation, and happy Veterans' Day. Hi Friend,

Whether you've been with me from the start or just heard from me for the first time at the debate, I couldn't be more grateful to have a chance to connect with you.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95264dad6dce4a468c731779c54a9f4c&_e=BRpT-gPIgVtLsXlxPDeS1YwU_A1ybV4HRAyb1yWQNIT0SS9oy7N9NxCwberCL2L0gJ_NvmErM5BqtGM8HFuWOJF2fC9i6LUagxfE82i8L5xzsumnfokjfZgXBRar_k6wKcb-ACqjZTLFxkweoOVBn_BohnZtlx-HCJF_7c4S0PWSFvEuqA1CH2LM6Mj9RrLtVOrCD1IDgr9rAon9tOrSLrGeTfDNzUWt36szj8KrjlXv6Qz4yezp9c8uMEhMIZZ3wZ6wh9F2WeRhOoUa7_9YACjfNs66CJwRw35P9YbuMMtPK8xQvstr3a_QjHhX3SFRdz1OqsJxYlDlRzQilL7VGn9gprfp1IpuviI4i9p5MRALShc3cdjPB4QYUqKrHyHHh0vqsNwwX5RH72EQpnYutNXJrYgr1zbo44Ybx4wLS6OPFcCYKNVNfFTtAApvG6cr9Hl9CMSTSU2uWdLkWMsF3nmAFgqwYOaOb6eyucrPk5gwo0_HeIe_V6jndwahqskvmviHBlkSIyglpB5eh2d5h5LtSARjgzDndS2_Nr8lHs7yfauF7CYpJaPBu190SdjGpAnZt6HneezVCzo-ijfSyeO9cbs1wO49U6mluCFlERY9iz707a4unPRUlYgy_smvYRPvmpUBHTmOML6ICMxg-Q%3D%3D "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95264dad6dce4a468c731779c54a9f4c&_e=BRpT-gPIgVtLsXlxPDeS1YwU_A1ybV4HRAyb1yWQNIT0SS9oy7N9NxCwberCL2L0gJ_NvmErM5BqtGM8HFuWOJF2fC9i6LUagxfE82i8L5xzsumnfokjfZgXBRar_k6wKcb-ACqjZTLFxkweoOVBn_BohnZtlx-HCJF_7c4S0PWSFvEuqA1CH2LM6Mj9RrLtVOrCD1IDgr9rAon9tOrSLrGeTfDNzUWt36szj8KrjlXv6Qz4yezp9c8uMEhMIZZ3wZ6wh9F2WeRhOoUa7_9YACjfNs66CJwRw35P9YbuMMtPK8xQvstr3a_QjHhX3SFRdz1OqsJxYlDlRzQilL7VGn9gprfp1IpuviI4i9p5MRALShc3cdjPB4QYUqKrHyHHh0vqsNwwX5RH72EQpnYutNXJrYgr1zbo44Ybx4wLS6OPFcCYKNVNfFTtAApvG6cr9Hl9CMSTSU2uWdLkWMsF3nmAFgqwYOaOb6eyucrPk5gwo0_HeIe_V6jndwahqskvYlYiZwTCrQtwEohPQdcJhWTl-8GaUIPd2xSQFdWNuPVUwUo0rhzQ-cQbG2UGLMQr1VDDaIS5T8tE53YVrQPFO9qyzOzVW8zm3iNUmwzgVuu2f7XkRhkshe6DQjSfva3tonBGcfCWeWaF4Q2hFMpIdQ%3D%3D)

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95264dad6dce4a468c731779c54a9f4c&_e=BRpT-gPIgVtLsXlxPDeS1YwU_A1ybV4HRAyb1yWQNIT0SS9oy7N9NxCwberCL2L0gJ_NvmErM5BqtGM8HFuWOJF2fC9i6LUagxfE82i8L5xzsumnfokjfZgXBRar_k6wKcb-ACqjZTLFxkweoOVBn_BohnZtlx-HCJF_7c4S0PWSFvEuqA1CH2LM6Mj9RrLtVOrCD1IDgr9rAon9tOrSLrGeTfDNzUWt36szj8KrjlXv6Qz4yezp9c8uMEhMIZZ3wZ6wh9F2WeRhOoUa7_9YACjfNs66CJwRw35P9YbuMMtPK8xQvstr3a_QjHhX3SFRdz1OqsJxYlDlRzQilL7VGn9gprfp1IpuviI4i9p5MRALShc3cdjPB4QYUqKrHyHHh0vqsNwwX5RH72EQpnYutNXJrYgr1zbo44Ybx4wLS6OPFcCYKNVNfFTtAApvG6cr9Hl9CMSTSU2uWdLkWMsF3nmAFgqwYOaOb6eyucrPk5gwo0_HeIe_V6jndwahqskv85jz-751jeaCx_eCLRTGzmWmFw-leGXusd1DpBX4rcACeEX8NgQeR8CWyzQn8sVO89W75Ls5YJOi-3UjnL3LEYkCaiIxvjSdJOKxbpGL4shrSYN_wvqsAw5j6nloPEgMEdUV2s3jEV-Ejub2-PbVFA%3D%3D)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Now, I think it's important to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | I launched my campaign for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. Now, I just completed my THIRD debate, and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in order to continue sharing this message across America! "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign post-debate. " Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will showcase the tremendous momentum we have gained since the last debate! "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the power of OUR movement?" | | | | | | | | | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, " I need your help â€“ starting right now. " Your support is what keeps our movement thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. Friend, This week saw major victories for progressives and working-class people across the country:
* Ohioans [voted in favor](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73094669/437369555/1552317059?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2FiN2U4ZDQtMzE3Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pmRoC0aIsMhWWq5Gtn3U_bPHzRlvrJg8DE_q8dpBhNU=&emci=171572ce-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=cab7e8d4-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=9848080) of enshrining reproductive freedom in the state’s constitution. This is a significant win in such a critical swing state, showing that abortion access remains a top concern.

* Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear, a Democrat in an overwhelmingly red state, was elected to a second term. Beshear has pushed to [protect and expand abortion rights](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73094670/437369556/-1600229753?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2FiN2U4ZDQtMzE3Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pmRoC0aIsMhWWq5Gtn3U_bPHzRlvrJg8DE_q8dpBhNU=&emci=171572ce-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=cab7e8d4-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=9848080) in Kentucky. He is a staunch supporter of organized labor, [joining striking UAW workers](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73094671/437369557/-155525249?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2FiN2U4ZDQtMzE3Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pmRoC0aIsMhWWq5Gtn3U_bPHzRlvrJg8DE_q8dpBhNU=&emci=171572ce-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=cab7e8d4-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=9848080) on the picket line in Louisville in September.

* Virginia Democrats regained the State House and maintained their majority in the State Senate with the election of seven progressive, working-class candidates and[ a promise to protect the right to choose](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73094672/437369558/-2087397376?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2FiN2U4ZDQtMzE3Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=pmRoC0aIsMhWWq5Gtn3U_bPHzRlvrJg8DE_q8dpBhNU=&emci=171572ce-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=cab7e8d4-317f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=9848080) in the Old Dominion.

So what can these wins tell us about 2024? Organizing around working-class concerns is not just the right thing to do morally and economically speaking, it’s strategically necessary. That means standing up for workers' right to organize, fighting for an economy that works for working people, and fighting for abortion rights. Moreover, it means standing up to right-wing extremists who seek to move our country backward. Thank you for your activism and all that you do. Together, we can create a stronger, more inclusive democracy and nation that benefits all of us. Onward,Ro

(That’s the closet! 👇) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73095216/437371415/209297649?refcode=ea.efb4562d-327f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ms=ea.efb4562d-327f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZmI0NTYyZC0zMjdmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JMfy_5XQCRuqCKjBXjw-o-iRbiLYBuT1XI2NCpIgrDc=) This was in the middle of COVID-19, and there wasn’t even six feet in the room to social distance. body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter]
Hello friends!
We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well.
Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, upcoming events, and other resources as we celebrate the results from the November 7th local, municipal and judicial elections.
NPP Celebrates Dan McCaffery's Election to PA Supreme Court!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/NPP%20Social_5.jpg]
The New Pennsylvania Project is still celebrating some incredible election results from Tuesday night! Not only was Judge Dan McCaffery elected to the PA Supreme Court, but we saw historic wins across the Commonwealth like Philadelphia electing its first woman mayor in Cherelle Parker, it's first openly-LGBTQ+ council member in Rue Landau, Montgomery County electing its first Indian-American commissioner in Neil Makhija, and Allegheny County electing Sara Innamorato as the first women to lead as county executive.
We also offer up a big congratulations to the voters of Pennsylvania on electing Judge McCaffery and we are proud to have knocked on more than 18,000 doors, sent 14,000 text messages to potential voters, made 60,000 phone calls (26,000 of which were completed), and sent 15,000 mailers to voters' homes in support of Judge McCaffery this election cycle. We were also part of a digital campaign with Commonwealth Communications that had more than 33 million impressions on social media!
Our organization is also encouraged by the increase in voter turnout for an odd-year election, as 3.04 million residents of the Keystone State voted on Tuesday. This 35.1 percent turnout of registered voters is up from 31.7 percent in 2021 and 29.6 percent in 2019.
That said, the work of our organization is nowhere near finished. We will quickly turn our attention back to civic education and voter registration in preparation for the 2024 Presidential election, and continue to provide civic engagement and advocate for participation in odd-year elections.
We hope you'll support us in our crucially important work to reach the underrepresented and underserved communities of Pennsylvania!
NPP in the News
How Abortion Became The Central Issue In Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court Race [https://www.penncapital-star.com/reproductive-rights/how-abortion-became-the-central-issue-in-pennsylvanias-supreme-court-race/]
(Penn Capital-Star)
Spending on the campaign topped $17 million by the end of October, campaign financial disclosures show, with large sums coming from conservative billionaires as well as reproductive rights organizations like Planned Parenthood Votes, the political arm of Planned Parenthood.
Democratic Judge Dan McCaffery Wins Pennsylvania Supreme Court Seat [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/democratic-judge-dan-mccaffery-wins-pennsylvania-supreme-court-seat/]
(Democracy Docket)
Voting rights groups, like the New Pennsylvania Project, are relieved as McCaffery’s presence on Pennsylvania’s highest court means that there is a bolstered pro-democracy bench heading into some critical election years for the battleground state. In a statement following the results, New Pennsylvania Project’s Kadida Kenner reminded that while a cause for celebration, Election Day is just one day, and, “the work of our organization is nowhere near finished.”
Are we really going to let Pa.’s richest man buy a state Supreme Court seat? [https://www.inquirer.com/opinion/yass-uhlein-pennsylvania-supreme-court-20231102.html]
(Philadelphia Inquirer)
Kadida Kenner is chief executive officer of the New Pennsylvania Project, a progressive-minded organization that aims to register new voters and increase turnout. They are working the Pennsylvania Supreme Court race the old-fashioned way, doorbell by doorbell. While the group says it has been remarkably successful in signing up new voters — some 30,000 in just 18 months — Kenner concedes that making those voters aware of the candidates and what’s at stake in the race for the state’s highest court can be an uphill climb.
Dark Money Has No Place In Pennsylvania Courts [https://buckscountybeacon.com/2023/11/opinion-dark-money-has-no-place-in-pennsylvania-courts/]
(Bucks County Beacon)
Like competitive sailing or horse racing, Pennsylvania politics now seem to many like a sport that only the wealthy can play. Big-money interest groups from outside the Commonwealth now dominate our elections, dumping million-dollar hauls into the coffers of politicians they hope to influence when the time comes to pass a bill. The reality is that these groups have become all stars in Harrisburg politics while regular Pennsylvanians are stuck on the bench.
Instagram of the Week
Twitter screenshot featuring Kadida Kenner at a Can't Trust Carluccio event [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/IMG_0213.jpg]
News You Can Use
Wins in local races will disrupt Michigan and Pennsylvania Democrats’ hold on legislative chambers [https://apnews.com/article/michigan-democrats-mayoral-majority-55cf27fd84efe8a5c9ef361e9316c834]
(AP News)
Michigan and Pennsylvania will emerge from the Tuesday elections with House legislative chambers evenly split between Republicans and Democrats in yet another sign of how narrowly divided the two swing states have become. The change will be at least temporary after House members in the states were elected to other offices and will need to resign from the legislatures.
Across the nation, Election Day results show that voters care about diversity and democracy | Editorial [https://www.inquirer.com/opinion/editorials/election-day-2023-democracy-landau-parker-ahmad-diversity-20231108.html]
(The Philadelphia Inquirer)
A majority of voters are clearly exhausted from the chaos and culture wars that Donald Trump and his band of MAGA followers have promoted during the past eight years. From governor’s mansions to state courts to school boards, voters do not want a handful of extreme officials imposing their narrow views on others. Instead, they want common sense, tolerance, and decency.
As Black Voters Drift to Trump, Biden’s Allies Say They Have Work to Do [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/06/us/politics/biden-trump-black-voters-poll-democrats.html]
(The New York Times)
A new Siena poll says Biden’s edge with Black voters, especially young voters, has faded over the course of his administration. Disgraced former president Donald Trump took 8 percent of the Black vote in 2020; now 22 percent of Black voters say they would support Trump, though many say they are open to returning to Biden.
Fitzpatrick Introduces Legislation To Designate Election Day a Federal Holiday [https://www.politicspa.com/fitzpatrick-introduces-legislation-to-designate-election-day-a-federal-holiday/127566/?oref=cspa_firstread_nl]
(PoliticsPA)
Congressman Brian Fitzpatrick (R-PA) introduced bipartisan legislation with Congresswoman Debbie Dingell (D-Mich.) to designate Election Day as a federal holiday.

clean_body: [] Hello friends! We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well. Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, upcoming events, and other resources as we celebrate the results from the November 7th local, municipal and judicial elections. NPP Celebrates Dan McCaffery's Election to PA Supreme Court! [] The New Pennsylvania Project is still celebrating some incredible election results from Tuesday night! Not only was Judge Dan McCaffery elected to the PA Supreme Court, but we saw historic wins across the Commonwealth like Philadelphia electing its first woman mayor in Cherelle Parker, it's first openly-LGBTQ+ council member in Rue Landau, Montgomery County electing its first Indian-American commissioner in Neil Makhija, and Allegheny County electing Sara Innamorato as the first women to lead as county executive. We also offer up a big congratulations to the voters of Pennsylvania on electing Judge McCaffery and we are proud to have knocked on more than 18,000 doors, sent 14,000 text messages to potential voters, made 60,000 phone calls (26,000 of which were completed), and sent 15,000 mailers to voters' homes in support of Judge McCaffery this election cycle. We were also part of a digital campaign with Commonwealth Communications that had more than 33 million impressions on social media! Our organization is also encouraged by the increase in voter turnout for an odd-year election, as 3.04 million residents of the Keystone State voted on Tuesday. This 35.1 percent turnout of registered voters is up from 31.7 percent in 2021 and 29.6 percent in 2019. That said, the work of our organization is nowhere near finished. We will quickly turn our attention back to civic education and voter registration in preparation for the 2024 Presidential election, and continue to provide civic engagement and advocate for participation in odd-year elections. We hope you'll support us in our crucially important work to reach the underrepresented and underserved communities of Pennsylvania! NPP in the News How Abortion Became The Central Issue In Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court Race [] (Penn Capital-Star) Spending on the campaign topped $17 million by the end of October, campaign financial disclosures show, with large sums coming from conservative billionaires as well as reproductive rights organizations like Planned Parenthood Votes, the political arm of Planned Parenthood. Democratic Judge Dan McCaffery Wins Pennsylvania Supreme Court Seat [] (Democracy Docket) Voting rights groups, like the New Pennsylvania Project, are relieved as McCaffery’s presence on Pennsylvania’s highest court means that there is a bolstered pro-democracy bench heading into some critical election years for the battleground state. In a statement following the results, New Pennsylvania Project’s Kadida Kenner reminded that while a cause for celebration, Election Day is just one day, and, “the work of our organization is nowhere near finished.” Are we really going to let Pa.’s richest man buy a state Supreme Court seat? [] (Philadelphia Inquirer) Kadida Kenner is chief executive officer of the New Pennsylvania Project, a progressive-minded organization that aims to register new voters and increase turnout. They are working the Pennsylvania Supreme Court race the old-fashioned way, doorbell by doorbell. While the group says it has been remarkably successful in signing up new voters — some 30,000 in just 18 months — Kenner concedes that making those voters aware of the candidates and what’s at stake in the race for the state’s highest court can be an uphill climb. Dark Money Has No Place In Pennsylvania Courts [] (Bucks County Beacon) Like competitive sailing or horse racing, Pennsylvania politics now seem to many like a sport that only the wealthy can play. Big-money interest groups from outside the Commonwealth now dominate our elections, dumping million-dollar hauls into the coffers of politicians they hope to influence when the time comes to pass a bill. The reality is that these groups have become all stars in Harrisburg politics while regular Pennsylvanians are stuck on the bench. Instagram of the Week Twitter screenshot featuring Kadida Kenner at a Can't Trust Carluccio event [] News You Can Use Wins in local races will disrupt Michigan and Pennsylvania Democrats’ hold on legislative chambers [] (AP News) Michigan and Pennsylvania will emerge from the Tuesday elections with House legislative chambers evenly split between Republicans and Democrats in yet another sign of how narrowly divided the two swing states have become. The change will be at least temporary after House members in the states were elected to other offices and will need to resign from the legislatures. Across the nation, Election Day results show that voters care about diversity and democracy | Editorial [] (The Philadelphia Inquirer) A majority of voters are clearly exhausted from the chaos and culture wars that Donald Trump and his band of MAGA followers have promoted during the past eight years. From governor’s mansions to state courts to school boards, voters do not want a handful of extreme officials imposing their narrow views on others. Instead, they want common sense, tolerance, and decency. As Black Voters Drift to Trump, Biden’s Allies Say They Have Work to Do [] (The New York Times) A new Siena poll says Biden’s edge with Black voters, especially young voters, has faded over the course of his administration. Disgraced former president Donald Trump took 8 percent of the Black vote in 2020; now 22 percent of Black voters say they would support Trump, though many say they are open to returning to Biden. Fitzpatrick Introduces Legislation To Designate Election Day a Federal Holiday [] (PoliticsPA) Congressman Brian Fitzpatrick (R-PA) introduced bipartisan legislation with Congresswoman Debbie Dingell (D-Mich.) to designate Election Day as a federal holiday. Upcoming Event! To understand how those elected this past Tuesday will impact the state, we're participating in a Zoom panel hosted by Spotlight PA on Thursday, Nov. 16 from 6 to 7PM. Panelists include: Katie Meyer, government editor and reporter, Spotlight PA Kadida Kenner, founding chief executive officer, New Pennsylvania Project * Deborah Gross, president & CEO, Pennsylvanians for Modern Courts The event is free to attend ( click here to register [] ) and will include a Q&A. Questions can be emailed ahead of time to events@spotlightpa.org. We hope you'll join us! Thank you for taking the time to stay informed. We'll be back in two weeks with the latest edition. In solidarity, #TeamNPP We're on a mission to register new voters in the Commonwealth and expand the electorate. Help us prepare for the upcoming municipal, judicial, and local elections in 2023! Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. name: Andy Kim
subject: Honoring our Veterans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey
body:
One of the greatest honors of serving my community in Congress is getting to work on behalf of our local veterans, servicemembers and their families. So, ahead of Veterans Day Weekend, I wanted to share some news.

Earlier this month, I was honored to receive the State of New Jersey Civilian Meritorious Service Award for continued service on behalf of servicemembers, the more than 350,000 veterans across New Jersey, and military families.

From the brave service members at Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst to those serving around the world, we have to support the brave people who put everything on the line for our country and freedoms - including once they retire and return to civilian life.

As the ranking member of the Armed Services Military Personnel Subcommittee, I'm committed to leading efforts to address the needs of servicemembers and their families, and to make sure their transition to civilian life is comfortable and easy.

I will continue to fight for and honor all of our Veterans today and every day — but this weekend, please take time to thank a service member in your life.

Andy

clean_body: One of the greatest honors of serving my community in Congress is getting to work on behalf of our local veterans, servicemembers and their families. So, ahead of Veterans Day Weekend, I wanted to share some news. Earlier this month, I was honored to receive the State of New Jersey Civilian Meritorious Service Award for continued service on behalf of servicemembers, the more than 350,000 veterans across New Jersey, and military families. From the brave service members at Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst to those serving around the world, we have to support the brave people who put everything on the line for our country and freedoms - including once they retire and return to civilian life. As the ranking member of the Armed Services Military Personnel Subcommittee, I'm committed to leading efforts to address the needs of servicemembers and their families, and to make sure their transition to civilian life is comfortable and easy. I will continue to fight for and honor all of our Veterans today and every day — but this weekend, please take time to thank a service member in your life. Fellow American -

**I have always known the importance of a good team.** _It’s why I married such a phenomenal woman and surround myself with God-fearing, hard-working, driven individuals every single day._

It is no secret that my team has grown exponentially in the last several weeks. As I sit in and out of meetings and interviews, I am astounded by the good people who are willing to serve our country. In fact, I am more hopeful than ever about the future of America.

**I am recruiting great American patriots who are determined to preserve the foundations this country was built on.** [**Today I am asking you to join my team. Let me explain why before you click out of this email.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fk3iNj1EK0Hs4G3PfsvLCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnL_LQP4RBAWh0dHBzOi8vbGFuZGluZy5taWtlam9obnNvbmZvcmxvdWlzaWFuYS5jb20vam9pbi10b2RheS8_-dUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

**Why I need your help:** _"Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction."_ As Ronald Reagan reminded us, we must always be on guard. This is especially true TODAY – as the Left is determined to dismantle the very foundations our great nation was founded upon.

Take a moment and consider what Democrats have pledged to _"re-engineer"_ – their new favorite buzzword: voting rights, gun rights, freedom of speech, education...the list goes on.

**The Left says they don't hate America, but they are working day and night to divide and destroy our country.**

Their actions speak louder than their words, [**and I need your help to fight back and protect our republic.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fk3iNj1EK0Hs4G3PfsvLCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnL_LQP4RBAWh0dHBzOi8vbGFuZGluZy5taWtlam9obnNvbmZvcmxvdWlzaWFuYS5jb20vam9pbi10b2RheS8_-dUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

As Speaker of the House, I am the new boogeyman. Democrats are coming at me with everything they have, to try and take back the House, un-seat vulnerable Republicans, and take over FULL control of Washington.

I know that saving our country from the radical Democratic agenda extends far beyond what I can do as one man, [**which is why I am assembling a team of foot soldiers I can rely on. I need to know you’ll have my back when I need you most.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fk3iNj1EK0Hs4G3PfsvLCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnL_LQP4RBAWh0dHBzOi8vbGFuZGluZy5taWtlam9obnNvbmZvcmxvdWlzaWFuYS5jb20vam9pbi10b2RheS8_-dUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

[** BE PART OF TEAM JOHNSON > **](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fk3iNj1EK0Hs4G3PfsvLCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnL_LQP4RBAWh0dHBzOi8vbGFuZGluZy5taWtlam9obnNvbmZvcmxvdWlzaWFuYS5jb20vam9pbi10b2RheS8_-dUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
Freedom is fragile and needs our vigilant protection. We need to expand our majority in 2024 to defend our country against the anti-American policies being pushed by the Left.

It’s time to come together, work as a team, and ensure the future of our country. [**I can’t do this without you.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Fk3iNj1EK0Hs4G3PfsvLCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnL_LQP4RBAWh0dHBzOi8vbGFuZGluZy5taWtlam9obnNvbmZvcmxvdWlzaWFuYS5jb20vam9pbi10b2RheS8_-dUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

| | The side of freedom won big in Ohio and Pennsylvania this week — two bellwether states that will decide who controls the Senate next year. In Ohio, voters approved – _by double-digit margins_ – ballot initiatives to secure reproductive rights and legalize marijuana. In Pennsylvania, Democrats significantly improved on their 2020 Presidential margins to win a key race for the State Supreme Court – which is likely to decide major cases in the years ahead on voting rights and choice. [**If you're fired up to carry on the momentum progressives just saw in these states, will you join me today and split a donation between my campaign and those of my good friends Sherrod Brown and Bob Casey?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73097878/437381362/-89146620?refcode=2023-11-09-split&recurring=0&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a2d4c5e5-387f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMmQ0YzVlNS0zODdmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S4rFZRzG2BTGDRLnzeRcaortOlXtNkt7LzCBaP_O-tE=) Across the country this week, we saw Americans pushing back on the GOP's extremist agenda and its attempts to set our country back 70 years. The message was clear: **when fundamental rights were on the ballots, voters chose the side pledging to protect those rights.** The fights to protect bodily autonomy, ensure access to the ballot box, and improve our justice system are far from over. Republicans are going to be putting up extremists on those issues all across the country next year — and they've made clear that Ohio and Pennsylvania are among their top targets in their push to retake the Senate. Sherrod Brown, up for re-election in Ohio next year, and Bob Casey, up for re-election in Pennsylvania, stand with the clear majority of their constituents who want freedom to live their lives free from government intrusion. subject: About Tuesday…
body:
You and I haven’t met yet but the events of this past Tuesday means that we absolutely should. We haven’t met yet, but Tuesday’s results show there is so much more we can achieve together. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x1WMFS2c5W5uP4nvROU-aKvP-C0nl5xG2yTST6pY4H94XoCTGsuVWSLJmEtlKXjynCmYvGSaXR0vFOYH-aNur-NphwJSvcsMxdFsL2JTQ7LtLVXBnktuFmvytZGqVTQqzM75Z7pK2LGyLaO5qY6gnDYRdcrsWpVuwp9hhpEVt86fYsfjAjglFugXbZhsd5uA5goConMvkihPbjpAF4UK-9uSMteqp-lJIf4CL35s2bvfMKYxFPKQtH4lyVD4pJC_nvnMKy-9TgZMLblZOJ6kiU/415/q6O1UEkbQ06ZYkhUYG8gbg/h0/G_WsLjTxBOK4EFryAAJE9zGym2czwFVb9iLiTHrP1bs)
---
Friend, You and I haven’t met yet, but my name is Jerrad Christian and I am the Democrat running to unseat Congressman Troy Balderson (R-OH) in Ohio’s 12th Congressional district - the Columbus suburbs and Appalachian portion of central Ohio. You probably aren’t too familiar with Ohio’s 12th district but here’s why this race matters. **This past Tuesday, Ohio voters came out in full force and demolished the Ohio GOP nixing their plans to implement a totalitarian abortion ban passed by our republican state legislature.**
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x1WMFS2c5W5uP4nvROU-aKxDS1_X1FaN2vH7CLuLBHJKmReyh26PY9-LaTno_UC68xr35AuR-Xe0o9blHKYcHpWGLT5GRliarXCZ3E-6rL3TPdlbMm-5EDpDSUkViWNP1Ye2Casx6n0l9xku2zhUjvaD-Lpo2jVH5S2ASKW5Mu_ntdq1y1pFdEG9DGD9WutxU8N1r-dJFMNVbryToF8dliaDpceMmW2oD_GR508D9MRB4Cbpn4BH6EETZQWV6v8ulgqWEKMXrm-BgErD_V_fSXbp0eZTM_2wlT3sU0Rlt_7w/415/q6O1UEkbQ06ZYkhUYG8gbg/h1/2uUTeNKqqch9BFw-k134S-9NTMl7QvD5A9i31-OWiI8)
---
In a state that voted for Mike DeWine and J.D. Vance just a few months after the _Dobbs_ decision struck down federal abortion rights, this is a big deal—**and it shows just how much things are changing here in battleground Ohio.** Tuesday’s vote showed that if we keep up the same momentum, engage with rural voters along with our urban coalition, we could flip districts like mine that lack real leadership and representation. To take back the House in 2024 we will need to flip districts like mine and I know our campaign can do it— _here’s why_ : Like many people in OH-12, I grew up in extreme poverty in the Appalachian region of Ohio - the kind of poverty that left me and my family uncertain about whether we'd have enough to eat the next day. After graduating high school, I made the decision to join the US Navy where I served as a flight deck fueler on an aircraft carrier during the global war on terror. After successfully surviving the hazards of the flight deck, I transitioned to the role of meteorologist where I learned about the inner workings of the earth’s climate and developed a lifelong passion for protecting the environment.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x1WMFS2c5W5uP4nvROU-aKxDS1_X1FaN2vH7CLuLBHJFwC2e6duiIeq29MoQhOykh-nvGqyIQMVmuKBHvaK9Vx1uRGd7G_4KCUzPtB7uSGxC0J1rLO926Wxy31Bh1we5KfhUDuHIr6HMidiYJ3M9Jc23Gq27-Vyo5Nxba4p0yZMS9xkikOXvq2VSaHIxvmTICcGGRPnrdPD198e2gUv-A4Guf57juC1eH5Hw3lzkuw4rgreFAe4T9qukOKE9O6PaEXwgelSYOAbELLiGL5TBTX_e46EEwOCwDphWis2tMrmg/415/q6O1UEkbQ06ZYkhUYG8gbg/h2/i4tTEIABs62VMNXZhpryJdKmos0sch_xeM-T85jO4es)
---
_(Left) A younger me in my Navy dress uniform. (Right) Me below deck in my re-fueler uniform. We wore purple uniforms to signify our role as re-fuelers._
---
Today, I am a father, a small business owner (my brother and I run a BBQ food truck) and I also work as a software engineer. My stint in the US Navy as a meteorologist gave me profound insight into climate and its workings, my experiences with poverty taught me the value of hard work and never taking money for granted, and **my roots in rural Ohio instilled in me the belief that when good people come together, there's no challenge we can't overcome**.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x1WMFS2c5W5uP4nvROU-aKxDS1_X1FaN2vH7CLuLBHJHdyJhO-AFum7ENb5oNz8aDBQ18YRru5KjBXJ0NnO57UJRSfKkZMULEnzZORkYmF6hVXwyTuuB0dytCm4cJTquqBEOqCD2r8okLnYiSNz0uMBzJS5iIPI97czLHN6-nUOjlMJUROzKLGk5X6WrqPXEVCLuJnZNcvjL6D8tBxVQXdEsrAnOWkCv1hbItAArD8yEBJdPiJsoChQAx1n0Cwsh8acBaz8sx50us0CdgP6aCYNFo52mz7KqOzfC0zqtK7YA/415/q6O1UEkbQ06ZYkhUYG8gbg/h3/MJZPQFtMtteVVzo7Ui8Vn8WdSMWnmsST6HV58oGNK8w)
---
_The people who I am fighting for._
---
A Republican for most of my life, after Trump came to power and I saw what his rhetoric of hate and division was doing to our country. I changed my voter registration and voted Democrat for the first time in my life, and I will never go back to the party that has supported him even after the violent January 6th insurrection that he encouraged and fomented with his ridiculous lies about the 2020 election. My opponent, right-wing extremist Congressman Troy Balderson (R-OH), is among those who spread Trump’s message of hate in the halls of Congress, and he was one of ultra MAGA Congressman Jim Jordan’s key backers during his run for House Speaker earlier this fall - he voted to elect him a whopping THREE TIMES. Here’s a few more of his lowlights:
* Before serving in Congress, Balderson ran a used car dealership that defrauded thousands of blue collar Ohioans

* He voted against the bipartisan infrastructure bill, then touted it as a victory in his district when it passed

* Failed to hold President Trump accountable for the Jan. 6 insurrection on our Capitol building

**As a father, Navy Vet, and entrepreneur, I know that Balderson is the worst kind of leader for rural Ohio and I am committed to bringing back real leadership to OH-12.** Thankfully, Balderson is more vulnerable than ever; and Tuesday's vote shows that regular Ohioans are ready to take our country back from right-wing extremism. When discussing my district, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC), states **“With this ever-changing district and an out of touch incumbent, voters are ready to flip OH-12.”** **[We can flip this seat and help Democrats take back the House, but only with strong support from donors across the country who are eager to help turn Ohio blue. Can you contribute $25 or more to help me and my team do the work to bring home a victory on Election Day next year?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953x1WMFS2c5W5uP4nvROU-aKxDS1_X1FaN2vH7CLuLBHJJ9lz7fWEOek7AIbMHiijgIckcm8d2uR8VCitCMU2P7P-OA3GVN_cOCD7gTIQnIkc49ZsKWbJ28TxQFFsKbF5IB5UON_7XAxC_g4Ur_fa-IP60v18vgCXYIjUIG3pds_9jR_iwqjwn_sHdVR84NaZAV0tHS7WhN_YLUlYK6gDGswFw9GS64hFRy0r3c7Se41wJ9IUGE8UMsSo5fOOOfJ89_kWh7UXXuD8KMvZrxeQGRPLC1Ta2w0S7g2V8st593J6Q/415/q6O1UEkbQ06ZYkhUYG8gbg/h4/yYj0KJdqnP9ugVRNQzfTS-wJEH68Lq1sjIuGy016gqE)**

You probably aren’t too familiar with Ohio’s 12th district but here’s why this race matters. This past Tuesday, Ohio voters came out in full force and demolished the Ohio GOP nixing their plans to implement a totalitarian abortion ban passed by our republican state legislature. | In a state that voted for Mike DeWine and J.D. Vance just a few months after the Dobbs decision struck down federal abortion rights, this is a big deal—and it shows just how much things are changing here in battleground Ohio. Tuesday’s vote showed that if we keep up the same momentum, engage with rural voters along with our urban coalition, we could flip districts like mine that lack real leadership and representation. To take back the House in 2024 we will need to flip districts like mine and I know our campaign can do it— here’s why : Like many people in OH-12, I grew up in extreme poverty in the Appalachian region of Ohio - the kind of poverty that left me and my family uncertain about whether we'd have enough to eat the next day. After graduating high school, I made the decision to join the US Navy where I served as a flight deck fueler on an aircraft carrier during the global war on terror. After successfully surviving the hazards of the flight deck, I transitioned to the role of meteorologist where I learned about the inner workings of the earth’s climate and developed a lifelong passion for protecting the environment. | (Left) A younger me in my Navy dress uniform. (Right) Me below deck in my re-fueler uniform. We wore purple uniforms to signify our role as re-fuelers. Today, I am a father, a small business owner (my brother and I run a BBQ food truck) and I also work as a software engineer. My stint in the US Navy as a meteorologist gave me profound insight into climate and its workings, my experiences with poverty taught me the value of hard work and never taking money for granted, and my roots in rural Ohio instilled in me the belief that when good people come together, there's no challenge we can't overcome. | The people who I am fighting for. A Republican for most of my life, after Trump came to power and I saw what his rhetoric of hate and division was doing to our country. I changed my voter registration and voted Democrat for the first time in my life, and I will never go back to the party that has supported him even after the violent January 6th insurrection that he encouraged and fomented with his ridiculous lies about the 2020 election. My opponent, right-wing extremist Congressman Troy Balderson (R-OH), is among those who spread Trump’s message of hate in the halls of Congress, and he was one of ultra MAGA Congressman Jim Jordan’s key backers during his run for House Speaker earlier this fall - he voted to elect him a whopping THREE TIMES. name: Jim Gaughran
subject: Let's Pick Ourselves Up
body:
https://jimgaughran.com/ [https://jimgaughran.com/]
Peter,
There’s no sugarcoating it - Tuesday wasn’t a great night for Democrats locally. However, we can celebrate a few great wins in the County Legislature like Rebecca Sanin’s triumph over an incumbent in the County Legislature and my good friend Steve Englebright’s victory in an open seat. Many of our candidates on the East End also prevailed, and here in Huntington, we re-elected our fantastic Receiver of Taxes Jillian Guthman. Unfortunately, many of our other candidates fought hard against the red tide and came agonizingly close, but didn’t prevail.
But we need to remember that we’ve been here before - and we’ve overcome even longer odds. In 2016, Donald Trump ran the table in Suffolk, and I lost a close race for State Senate against an entrenched incumbent. After that, Long Island Democrats didn’t give up - we got smarter. In 2018 I raised more money, recruited more volunteers, and came back to beat that same incumbent by a large margin. And there’s no reason we can’t plan to make a big comeback in 2024 as well .
As we saw elsewhere in the country, Democrats notched big wins this year by standing up for people’s rights and defying GOP extremism. If we elect a Democratic House next year, we can pass a law that enshrines women’s right to abortion across the country. We can protect entitlement programs that the GOP would gladly slash just to give billionaires another tax cut. We can show the voters of Long Island that Democrats side with the people.
I’ll be out here working every day to be the strongest candidate I can. I would greatly appreciate any donation you can make to help my campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jim-gaughran-for-congress-1] . And when you’re ready to fight, I hope you’ll join me on the trail.
Sincerely,
Jim

I'm Dave, and I'm running for office because I'm tired of the same old politicians who make promises they won't keep. I’m not a career politician – I'm a proud U.S. Army veteran who served in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War. I've also had decades of experience in business and government, **[but it's my military service that has prepared me most to fight for our Commonwealth and renew our American spirit.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=43077ccc31b74cc9b479b41a7e12ee35&_e=-P9gbyJ4H3bJ133tityRuDxiJM7wLHHu41-voqS6i9Y9_1h_pc0kyemtgH5iclhbP7Ji9bm0Kr_EsY_sT0eNSfxEdPfuSNRKcD1i9X1cFHGHG0Yj3q1FyMuFXzIr3QzU3508zip6sPiwksj0b2JMIF0ZcUQvIQy4Y8t8G_G2Z22x536JbChw0bDBsRL0mMOpPwhhHul8HuFgK4iVLy0o_H8p9BBN-xN9MArQ1w8BKomposHxoKTtq8YhL8vApAhkfvBkLSuNvfE6087ly7R4pPGhFYiWKTqxeBV5tRZ0wbQjiLA-UaxBlx-S-WMi0JMskcyFtiI631PROzAfCvi28qtNAaztj2hk09_cDDtTjM3wjlbJFGSdHjUFq7UOlUno4gIbhcc5C-IuPJbGAkSaIvePy1plFohf7sQ2jKvye6h1u7fl_74m9JILqYKnxrRE)**

I’ve learned that leadership is about more than just giving speeches and making promises. It’s about making tough decisions, even when they’re not popular. **[It’s about putting the needs of the people first.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=43077ccc31b74cc9b479b41a7e12ee35&_e=-P9gbyJ4H3bJ133tityRuDxiJM7wLHHu41-voqS6i9Y9_1h_pc0kyemtgH5iclhbP7Ji9bm0Kr_EsY_sT0eNSfxEdPfuSNRKcD1i9X1cFHGHG0Yj3q1FyMuFXzIr3QzU3508zip6sPiwksj0b2JMIF0ZcUQvIQy4Y8t8G_G2Z22x536JbChw0bDBsRL0mMOpPwhhHul8HuFgK4iVLy0o_H8p9BBN-xN9MArQ1w8BKomposHxoKTtq8YhL8vApAhkfvBkLSuNvfE6087ly7R4pM8is8joSwBr5Qpc-VZ6nc8e7aT1gBBS-bKoeVoN0-msQBQhTfso0C6kGzNhAYQhMKbWKtyZv_1YSeGsuTrFJvo2I9vJ6UKQhZPEcw5LvL-FWHCl7FAzkhqFvMhxUIlE3OJgx5Xpr0Gji0PIcgvpFPpsYQk9lor6HVL22KUtEBCK)** Out of all the things I’ve done in my life, nothing has been more rewarding than serving my country. It’s what made me into the person I am today. Our country is now facing a crisis. But to fix it, we need to break the status quo and elect a battle-tested leader who is willing to fight for what's right.

Now, I’m committed to making sure that same dream is still possible for every American in Pennsylvania.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=43077ccc31b74cc9b479b41a7e12ee35&_e=-P9gbyJ4H3bJ133tityRuDxiJM7wLHHu41-voqS6i9Y9_1h_pc0kyemtgH5iclhbP7Ji9bm0Kr_EsY_sT0eNSfxEdPfuSNRKcD1i9X1cFHGHG0Yj3q1FyMuFXzIr3QzU3508zip6sPiwksj0b2JMIF0ZcUQvIQy4Y8t8G_G2Z22x536JbChw0bDBsRL0mMOpPwhhHul8HuFgK4iVLy0o_H8p9BBN-xN9MArQ1w8BKomposHxoKTtq8YhL8vApAhkfvBkLSuNvfE6087ly7R4pPI3yxdFqXCVtFLEg79Y5cETLI985z11_smX9J5DTK5LHacTl51L__Z1KjF0snpAlb7cJALAqjAoAGMtdeMOrevA4X9XotoEnnohvccpOmWxCIUW83B-RosHzIZ2dtRwzyt1mk6y2M4tZi2_dcPQ8rfVCXMvRJEW-E9oF3CO3NtV)**

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

clean_body: | | | | Peter, this isn't looking good. We just heard from our finance director, donations have slowed dramatically, and we fell short of our end-of-month deadline. We'll be honest: October donations were down significantly and we can't afford to fall short of another goal this year. In the next few days, we'll be budgeting our campaign expenses through the end of this year – and if we fall short of our November goal, we'll have to scale back our campaign significantly. We can't let that happen. That's why we must raise another $28,370 by the end of this month. | Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse.
