subject: I have been honored to represent the region where I grew up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73101116/437392817/-2027002553?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzNzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjNkYjM2ZjItNDI3Zi1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=HDUaor-IbTBYtekD21vBZf0NPSLdsIMij9F5zok9Nuc=&emci=e5ff7e2a-227f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=23db36f2-427f-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=3595835)

Peter –

Most folks know that my most important title isn’t “Congressman” – it’s “Dad.” My two kids, and my desire to make the world better and stronger for them, has driven my public service.

In fact, nearly every time I flew to DC in the past decade, I’d start the flight by emailing Sophie and Aven, explaining to them why I was leaving – and what I’d be working on in our nation’s capital. Over the years, they’ve likely heard far more than they wanted to about my work to create jobs, improve access to health care, make Congress work better, fulfill the promises made to Indian Country, combat climate change, secure funding wins for our region, and so many other topics.

Without fail, I’d end my notes to them with two sentences – “Be good. I love you.”

In every letter I tried to communicate to them that every day, in every way, I was trying make things better for their generation – and for their country.

Recently, I shared another letter with my kids. I told them what I am now sharing with you, my friends and supporters: **I will not seek re-election next year.**

I never intended for this chapter to be something I’d do for the rest of my life, and after nearly two decades in public service, I’m excited to start a new chapter when my term is complete.

I’m extraordinarily grateful for the support you’ve given me during this time. With your trust and support, I’ve been able to work on projects that matter.

Among other things, I was honored to lead the Select Committee on the Modernization of Congress (aka “The Fix Congress Committee”). Not only did our committee pass over 200 proposed reforms geared toward making Congress work better, we demonstrated a better way of doing things, checking partisan agendas at the door and just focusing on solving problems. For the next 14 months, I’ll be continuing that work as Chair of the new Fix Congress Caucus. And when I’m outside the institution, I’ll continue doing all I can to make things better.

I have been honored to represent the region where I grew up, the Olympic Peninsula. My upbringing shaped me as a person and as a leader. It’s why my office’s core mission has been “creating more opportunity for more people in more places.” Whether it’s been helping folks get broadband access, securing funding for ports, fighting for rural hospitals, delivering funds to address flooding, or standing up a new program (called RECOMPETE grants) to help areas facing persistent economic challenges, I’ve been proud to work for the Olympic Peninsula every single day.

There are other projects I’ve told my kids about over the years, trying to help them understand that we can do things better when we do things together. Whether working in coalitions to fix the traffic problems at Gorst, to manage our forests in a smarter way, to get a new veterans clinic built, to ensure the federal government fulfills its trust responsibilities to tribal communities, to build more affordable housing in Tacoma, or to protect Puget Sound, our team has worked in a collaborative way and done good things.

As nourishing as this job has been, it has come with profound costs to my family. Missed concerts and theater performances. Missed family dinners. The distance I felt from my family for months after the events of January 6th. I didn’t always deliver for them in the way I intended; and I hope they will forgive me for that. And I hope they know – and I hope you know – that I was really trying my best to make the world better for them and for the people I represent.

For me, that work isn’t complete. For one, I intend to keep the pedal to the metal for the next 14 months until my final minute on the job. There’s a lot to do! Beyond that ... I’ve got more chapters in me. My plan is to ensure those chapters enable me to continue to make a positive difference. And I’d sure like to make more time for those I love.

No matter how the next chapter is written, I’ll keep telling my kids “Be good. I love you.”

Thank you again for your help and support. More soon....

Best,

Derek

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73102613/437398024/-233825198?refcode=em-11.09.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMDAxNzA2Yi00NjdmLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C47OfHyhw3JPXoCwsyg3Fho9kNsbX_f2JCNt0Sbivt4=)

Robert Garcia, Rep. Salud Carbajal, the Southern California Armenian Democrats, and the Asian Democrats of Los Angeles.

**_“Pencil neck, Adam Schiff._** Guy’s got the smallest neck I’ve ever seen... it’s like the size of a finger. I don’t know how it holds up his head – which is _**oversized.**_ I don’t know how it holds it up. It’s an engineering marvel.
_**Adam Shifty Schiff... Pelosi**_ , who’s _**crazy**_ , by the way, she’s **_nuts_** ...The **_worst_** people. _**The worst people by far are politicians.”**_
After yet another bizarre attack from the twice-impeached, four-times indicted ex-president,**here’s what happens next:**
After the live _Newsmax_ broadcast from his rally, the conservative website _The Daily Caller_ (founded by Tucker Carlson) and _Fox News_ aggregated his attack and spread it online.
And every time Trump attacks me, we see an increase in calls and letters to our campaign and congressional office — _with more attacks, threats of violence, and even death threats._
And look, I’m used to it by now. It’s a price I willingly pay for upholding my oath of office and defending our democracy from Trump for all of these years.
But here’s the bottom line, Derek:
California has 22 million registered voters, and we’re trying to reach every one of them before early voting starts in less than 100 days. What’s more, California has an open primary where everyone can vote regardless of party, meaning the people watching these Trump attacks on _Fox_ will help decide the primary.
**If Trump reaches them with more unhinged attacks like this before we do, we may not have the time — or the resources — to fight back and share the truth before early voting begins.**
That’s why we absolutely _cannot_ let this moment pass us by and allow Trump’s attacks to pick up steam. Especially as we’re less than four months to our March primary.
**[So Derek, I’m personally asking: Will you make a contribution of $3 or any amount to my campaign today to help us respond to this latest attack from Donald Trump, share our message across California, and win this Senate race?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2023_abs_em.uaqk5d&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20231109_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=12&akid=4432%2E5257348%2EBs-QM-)**
There is nothing that Donald Trump fears more than me holding him and his cronies accountable in the United States Senate. (Except maybe a criminal jury doing the same.)
With your support today, that’s exactly what I plan to do.
Thanks for chipping in,
Adam

In 2024, we will, of course, see many nationally significant federal races, in addition to key down-ballot races across the country. To have the impact we need to in these races, my team and I need your help to keep up our strong momentum – = | = As our window to reign in planet-warming corporate pollution shrinks, it’s up to all of us to dig in and help replace deep-pocketed fossil fuel company allies with climate champions to ensure a clean energy future and a livable planet for all of our communities. # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
NOVEMBER 9, 2023

CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**San Diego Working Waterfront Endorses Former Mayor Kevin Faulconer For Supervisor**
SAN DIEGO, CA -- Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, announced the endorsement of the San Diego Working Waterfront, formerly known as the San Diego Port Tenant’s Association. The latest endorsement continues to show his growing momentum since launching his campaign earlier this year.
Formerly known as the San Diego Port Tenants Association, San Diego Working Waterfront is a large coalition of businesses and industries dedicated to enhancing trade, recreation, commerce, and tourism on San Diego Bay’s tidelands, while steadfastly protecting the area’s environment. The businesses involved generate more than 9.4 billion to the regional economy, employing more than 70,000 San Diegans.
**“Kevin Faulconer is the right candidate to bring back common sense to the Board of Supervisors,” said Sharon Cloward, President & CEO, San Diego Working Waterfront. “His work to protect our waterways, keeping our streets clean and reducing homelessness as Mayor of San Diego will be valuable at the county level. Our coalition can rely on Kevin Faulconer to help implement smart solutions to help keep tourists visiting our county and help protect our waterfront.”**
**“I’m grateful for the support of one of the largest employers in the county helping to generate billions to our local economy,” said Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for Supervisor in District Three. “I’m going to be working with this coalition to keep our waterways open, our streets clean and help show the world everything San Diego has to offer.”**
As the Mayor of San Diego, Faulconer worked tirelessly with local providers to provide safe and sanitary shelter for thousands of struggling San Diegans. As Mayor, working in tandem with the City Council and community leaders, Faulconer led City efforts to implement a firm but compassionate approach to homelessness. These efforts proved successful, helping to clean up the streets and reduce the number of people living on the streets in unsanitary conditions.
###

name: Elissa Slotkin for Michigan
subject: Peter Meijer flips his stance on Trump
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=788%2E135344%2EENO3GB)

Friend --
This week, former U.S. Representative Peter Meijer launched his race for U.S. Senate here in Michigan. When Peter Meijer first announced his campaign, we told you to watch as he tries to convince Trump voters to support him after he so publicly voted to impeach him in 2021.
And since he launched his campaign this week, he has twisted himself into knots to make it work.
Peter Meijer was one of just 10 House Republicans to vote to impeach Trump in 2021, and at the time he claimed it was to hold Trump accountable for his response to the January 6th insurrection. But now, he doesn’t seem to think that attack on our democracy is disqualifying to someone seeking to hold the office of President.
**On day one, Meijer flipped and minimized the January 6th insurrection – saying it was just _“one day.”_** And last week, right before announcing, he filed a court brief defending Trump’s ability to be on the ballot in Michigan next year, despite his involvement in January 6th. He went on to say he would vote for Donald Trump in 2024 and said “I have probably spent more time defending Donald Trump than saying critical things of him.”
We all understand what he’s attempting to do: Meijer is trying to rehabilitate his image with base Republican voters to have a chance at winning the primary – contradicting his past claims and actions as a leader who would stand up to Trump. Unlike some Republicans who broke with Trump and stuck to their principles, even when they lost their jobs, Meijer has decided to flip and recant, rather than stick to a principled approach to Trump.
[**Meijer's entry into the race is a big inflection moment for our campaign, which is why we're asking people like you to help send Elissa Slotkin to the U.S. Senate.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov23.RK33_Y&refcode=em231109-2-tt&t=2&akid=788%2E135344%2EENO3GB) Peter Meijer has given his past campaigns over $1.6 million, and we know he has the ability to self-fund even more in this Senate race.**

After weeks without a Speaker of the House, Republicans finally settled on a new leader: **Louisiana Congressman Mike Johnson**.
**I know what you’re thinking: “who is Mike Johnson?!”**
You’re not the only one. We’re all just now learning about the man who will be second in line to the presidency—and none of it is good. Speaker “MAGA Mike Johnson” is about as extreme and far-right as they come.
[**I’ll explain just how extreme below. Peter, let me give you a quick snapshot into just how extreme the new Republican Speaker Mike Johnson is:
* **He supports a national abortion ban.** He even proposed “hard labor” for any doctor who performs an abortion.
* **He was an architect of Trump’s coup attempt.** He led 125 House Republicans in urging the Supreme Court to throw out election results.
* **He wants to ban same-sex marriage.** Johnson called homosexuality “inherently unnatural” and a “dangerous lifestyle.”
* **He blamed mass shootings on abortion and the teaching of evolution.** Johnson said when you allow abortion, then you are teaching that “life has no value,” so we “wind up with school shooters.”

Peter,**** Mike Johnson isn’t just extreme, he’s dangerous. If he’s successful in enacting the MAGA agenda, our fundamental rights AND democracy are even more at risk.
**That’s why we have to do everything in our power to fight back against far-right extremism—and organize and mobilize voters to support change in 2024. My team and I are working hard to do just that. But we need your support.**
[**Can you chip in $10, $20, or whatever you can to support Team Casar in this fight? Help us bring the giving season to families in our community.
#
Last year, we gave out over 200 turkeys to families at Thanksgiving who didn’t have one. **This year, we hope to double that number.**
[Thanksgiving is two weeks away. Will you chip in $5 or anything you can today to help us bring some joy into homes around NYC this year? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231109-turkeys.YgryUU&refcode=em20231109-5289-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5289%2E2526796%2EOmbznA)

****
We’re teaming up with NYC public housing developments, community organizations, houses of worship, food pantries and local elected officials to **give hundreds of families an opportunity to celebrate community, mutual aid, and gratitude.**
Many of the organizations we partner with to distribute turkeys — such as the Youth Ministries for Peace & Justice and Glebe Senior Houses — focus on uplifting our most vulnerable communities, including immigrants new to the U.S. and senior citizens.
We’ve run the numbers, and $15-$20 means a family without a turkey gets to share in the Thanksgiving season.
[Can you chip in $5 or anything you can today to help us make that happen?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231109-turkeys.YgryUU&refcode=em20231109-5289-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5289%2E2526796%2EOmbznA)

Team AOC

body:
Re-electing Bob Casey is mission-critical.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=1098%2E552475%2Ed27Xp3)
Re-electing Bob Casey has never been more important, Peter.

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: I stand with Rashida Tlaib
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
As Rashida said herself, she will not be silenced and she will not let anyone distort her words. Her perspective is needed now more than ever.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=702%2E791427%2E96cBY0)

Friend,
Earlier this week, the House GOP, along with 22 Democrats, voted to censure my friend, my sister-in-service, and the only Palestinian-American in Congress, Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib.
I stood with Rashida on the House floor in solidarity, and I'm reaching out today to call out the hypocrisy of this cowardly censure — the hypocrisy of targeting a duly-elected member of Congress bravely representing and advocating on behalf of her constituents, her family, and her beliefs.
In truth, this act is just one part of a pattern. A pattern of dehumanization, dismissal, and denial of Palestinian human rights.
For decades, our political discourse failed to acknowledge the humanity of Palestinians, much less included the voices of Muslims like Rashida and me.
For decades, our politicians have routinely denied and turned a blind eye on the occupation of the West Bank. They've re-written history, denying the Nakba — the mass expulsion of Palestinians in 1948 — ever took place.
Some even deny the existence of Palestinians as a people.
Routine settler violence against Palestinian civilians, the demolition of Palestinians’ ancestral homes, the destruction of their lands, and the brutalization, subjugation, and pain inflicted on the Palestinian people are too-often met with impunity by Israeli forces and enablement by the United States.
Independent human-rights groups — including Israel’s own B’Tselem — have repeatedly reported that Israel's violations of international law amount to the crime of apartheid. These independent reports are then shamefully slandered as anti-Semitic.
Over the past month, in the wake of this war, we have witnessed blatantly-genocidal rhetoric from leading Republicans.
Senator Lindsey Graham went on national television to declare a “religious war," saying we should "level " the Gaza Strip — a 141-square-mile area of over 2 million people, over half of them children.
Marco Rubio, when asked specifically about avoiding civilian casualties in Gaza, said Israel cannot co-exist with “these savages." That "they have to be eradicated.”
Max Miller went on television to tell the world that Gaza would be "turned into a parking lot."
Where is the outcry for that? Where is their censure on the floor of the U.S. Congress?
Moreover, where is the condemnation of the killing of over 10,000+ Palestinians in Gaza?
As Rashida said herself, she will not be silenced and she will not let anyone distort her words. Her perspective is needed now more than ever.
I am proud to stand with Rashida today and all days — and together, alongside this movement, we will do all that we can to advance the cause of dignity, humanity, and peace for ALL in the face of oppression here and across the globe.
Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

The Binkley campaign has met the donor requirement for the third Republican debate, with now over 74,000 unique donors verified by the Republican National Committee. In case you missed it, the U.S. House formally passed a resolution to
censure Rashida Tlaib in a disgusting attempt to silence her — and almost
two dozen Democrats supported it.

AIPAC and moderate Democrats would love to see Rashida, a progressive
champion and the only Palestinian American member of Congress, ousted next
November.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231109-rt.4u-X8W&refcode=em20231109-31775&amount=3&t=1001&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]Will you fuel her re-election fight by splitting a grassroots donation
between Justice Democrats and Rashida’s campaign now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231109-rt.4u-X8W&refcode=em20231109-31775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]Contribute $3

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter,

Late last night, a majority of Republicans and 22 so-called Democrats
voted to formally censure Rashida Tlaib for her courageous commitment to
human rights.

By punishing Rashida, the House took its anti-Palestinian bigotry out on
the only Palestinian American in Congress as members of both parties came
together to disgustingly celebrate their shared prejudice and
dehumanization of Palestinian people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231109-rt.4u-X8W&refcode=em20231109-31775&amount=3&t=1021&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]We at Justice Democrats stand with Rashida, now and always. Will you
help us fight back against these ugly attacks from both sides of the aisle
and re-elect her next November by splitting a grassroots donation today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231109-rt.4u-X8W&refcode=em20231109-31775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1040&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]Contribute $3

Before the House voted, fellow Squad members and Justice
Democrats-endorsed representatives like Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and
Ayanna Pressley stood up for Rashida with moving remarks. She then gave a
powerful speech in defense of her calls for a ceasefire and release of
hostages:

“I am the only Palestinian American serving in Congress, and my
perspective is needed here now more than ever. I will not be silenced and
I will not let anyone distort my words.

I can’t believe I have to say this, but Palestinian people are not
disposable. We are human beings just like anyone else. The cries of the
Palestinian and Israeli children sound no different to me.”

Instead of working together to save lives as the Palestinian casualty
count surpasses 10,000 people (including more than 4,000 children) in just
one month, these 22 Democrats shamefully chose to focus on silencing their
colleague:

Steve Cohen, Jim Costa, Angie Craig, Don Davis, Lois Frankel, Jared
Golden, Dan Goldman, Josh Gottheimer, Greg Landsman, Susie Lee, Kathy
Manning, Jared Moskowitz, Wiley Nickel, Chris Pappas, Marie Gluesenkamp
Perez, Pat Ryan, Brad Schneider, Kim Schrier, Darren Soto, Ritchie Torres,
Debbie Wasserman Schultz, and Frederica Wilson.

Make no mistake: this fight to punish Rashida is based on blatant lies and
racist, Islamophobic talking points. It’s telling that they chose to
censure Rashida’s call for peace and freedom in Palestine, but not:

* Republican Max Miller, who said Gaza would be turned into a “parking
lot.”
* Republican Brian Mast, who compared Palestinians to Nazis.
* Republican Ryan Zinke, who introduced a bill to expel Palestinians
from the United States.

While Republicans and moderate Democrats try to paint Rashida as a fringe
extremist, the majority of people in the United States and 71% of Michigan
Democrats stand with her on the right side of history in support of a
ceasefire.

As the ONLY Palestinian American in Congress, we need Rashida’s
perspective, representation, and courage now more than ever, and Justice
Democrats will do everything in our power to re-elect her one year from
now.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231109-rt.4u-X8W&refcode=em20231109-31775&amount=3&t=1041&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]But we can’t do it without you. I know we’ve asked for a lot lately,
but please consider donating $3 or whatever you can afford
to Justice Democrats and Rashida’s campaign to defend her seat in Congress
next year.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231109-rt.4u-X8W&refcode=em20231109-31775&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1060&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]Contribute $3

We will not sit idly by while bigots in both parties attempt to silence
Rashida for using her freedom of speech to stand up for the human rights
of ALL.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

this is a difficult time.

using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1062&akid=31775%2E1203867%2Eo3pZlp ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

This is monumental news: **Ohioans just resoundingly voted to enshrine abortion access in our state’s constitution!** Voters came out in droves to send a clear message: Ohioans believe women’s health care decisions should be between them and their doctors, not politicians.

Moments like this make me especially proud to be an Ohioan — and to represent my state in the Senate. Now that we've protected abortion access in Ohio, I promise you that I'll continue to work every day to make sure women’s rights to make their own health care decisions are also protected nationwide.

But here's the deal: I'm up for reelection, and **I'm running against three anti-abortion extremists — all of whom would support a national abortion ban.** The latest polls show us neck and neck, and our Democratic Senate majority is up for grabs. If I'm going to win this race and protect abortion rights from Mitch McConnell, I need your immediate grassroots support.

**So today, as we celebrate this victory, I'm personally asking you to help me keep up our momentum:[Will you chip in $28 or more now, split between me and Elizabeth Warren, to defend Ohio's Democratic seat and protect our pro-choice Senate majority?](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/977?amount=28&t=8&akid=1813%2E4032634%2EBxw3Jq)****** | [**CONTRIBUTE**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/977?t=9&akid=1813%2E4032634%2EBxw3Jq)
